title: Sr. Bioinformatics Scientist
description:
ABOUT SINGULAR GENOMICS

Singular Genomics is inventing at the forefront of genomics, one of the world’s fastest-growing industries. The commercially available G4® Sequencing Platform is a powerful, highly versatile benchtop genomic sequencer designed to produce fast and accurate results. In addition, the company is currently developing the G4X™ Spatial Sequencer, an upgrade to the G4, which will leverage Singular’s proprietary sequencing technology, applying it as an in situ readout for transcriptomics, proteomics and fluorescent H&E in tissue, with spatial context. Singular Genomics’ mission is to empower researchers and clinicians to advance science and medicine.

We foster a culture of creativity and technical excellence, both catalysts for innovation. We celebrate diversity, emphasize collaboration and, as we rapidly mature, we are constantly looking at ways we can do better for our people.

Our Headquarters are located on the Torrey Pines Mesa, in La Jolla, California at the center of the biotech hub. Our Manufacturing facility is in Sorrento Valley.

 

Position Summary:

As a Senior Scientist on the Bioinformatics team, you will play a key role in expanding Singular Genomics' spatial biology platform and service offerings. This position sits at the intersection of computational biology, assay development, and hands-on scientific computing. You will report into the Bioinformatics functional group and, initially, be matrixed into the Panel Design team to focus on its most pressing needs. Your initial focus will be supporting the design and optimization of targeted in situ transcriptomics panels for tissue- and disease-specific applications. This includes selecting biologically informative genes for cell type identification, defining pathway-focused content that enables cell-state interpretation, and developing computational tools to automate and improve panel design. As the platform and services continue to evolve, you will contribute to the development of spatial bioinformatics workflows, analysis pipelines, and computational methods that enable customers to generate meaningful biological insight from spatial multiomics data. This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys applying computational approaches to challenging biological problems while building software that directly impacts cutting-edge products and services. This position can be remote or hybrid/on-site. If remote, travel to the headquarters in San Diego, CA will be required at least quarterly.

Responsibilities:

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Support the computational design and optimization of targeted spatial transcriptomics panels for tissue- and disease-specific applications.
  • Define biologically relevant panel content by integrating current literature, public datasets, and pathway knowledge to support cell type annotation and cell state characterization.
  • Develop computational methods and software tools for automated panel design, probe evaluation, and panel optimization.
  • Collaborate closely with molecular biology, chemistry, and assay development teams to iteratively improve probe performance and panel quality.
  • Evaluate panel performance using internal datasets and external spatial and single-cell reference atlases.

Spatial Bioinformatics

  • Develop and maintain analysis pipelines for spatial transcriptomics and spatial multiomics datasets.
  • Apply modern spatial bioinformatics methods to support sequencer / assay development and biological interpretation, including cell typing, differential expression, pathway analysis, spatial neighborhood analysis, and cell-state characterization.
  • Work with scientists across R&D to develop new analysis capabilities that support expanding service offerings.
  • Stay current with advances in spatial biology, single-cell genomics, and computational biology, incorporating new approaches where appropriate.

Scientific Software & Automation

  • Write clear, workable code (primarily Python) to automate panel design, analysis, and other repetitive scientific tasks.
  • Build and maintain automated analysis workflows that make routine spatial and single-cell analyses repeatable and easy to run. 

Qualifications:

  • PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Candidates with an MS plus industry experience will also be considered.
  • Experience analyzing spatial transcriptomics, single-cell sequencing, or related genomics datasets.
  • Strong understanding of tissue biology, cell type annotation, and pathway-based biological interpretation.
  • Proficiency writing analysis code in Python; able to produce clear, workable code without requiring production-software polish.
  • Experience building automated analysis workflows or pipelines. • Working knowledge of Linux-based computational environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing targeted sequencing or hybridization-based panels.
  • Experience with probe design, oligonucleotide design, or molecular assay development.
  • Experience with single-cell analysis frameworks such as Scanpy, Squidpy, Seurat, or similar.
  • Knowledge of cancer biology, immunology, or tissue-specific biology.
  • Experience developing workflow pipelines using Nextflow.
  • Familiarity with containerization (e.g., Docker) and reproducible-environment tooling.
  • Software-engineering rigor (testing, CI/CD, packaging) is welcome but not expected at this level.
  • Experience with cloud computing environments (AWS preferred). • Familiarity with image-based spatial technologies or microscopy data.
  • Experience with primary analysis methods such as image processing, feature detection, registration, or sequencing base calling is a plus but not required..

 

The estimated base salary range for this role based in the United States of America is: $131,600 - $154,800. Additionally, this role is eligible for to receive equity as part of the compensation package. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s qualifications, location where the role is to be performed, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Should the level of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable salary range may be updated accordingly.

 

Singular Genomics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 

Singular Genomics is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants with physical or mental disabilities. Applicants with a disability who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process can provide their name and contact information to our Accommodations team at accommodationsrequest@singulargenomics.com. Your request will be responded to as soon as possible.

title: AI Biologist - Cancer Biology (Applications)
description: AI Biologist - Cancer Biology (Applications) Latch builds rigorous, scientific benchmarks ( benchmarks.bio ) for AI agents across biology. We work with frontier labs and pharma to measure whether agents can handle real biological workflows; the messy, multi-layer reasoning that matters in the field. About the Role Our work in Cancer Biology means measuring whether an agent can take a tumor case from raw molecular data to a real clinical decision. You'll identify real cancer-biology datasets and turn them into rigorous, deterministically-graded tasks. Our benchmarks are agentic and cross-domain. Each task hands an agent the artifacts a cancer researcher would actually have and asks for a concrete conclusion. Your job is to establish defensible reference analyses and scoring criteria across conclusion types, the benchmark measures that span basic cancer biology to clinical outcomes. You'll anticipate where agents take plausible but wrong turns and test whether they can handle experimental variability, incomplete data, conflicting evidence, and mechanism-driven tradeoffs. Our team emphasizes cross-domain integration and long-horizon reasoning. Requirements 1+ years personally working in basic, translational, or clinical cancer biology. Experience with hands on analysis of multi-omic tumor data hands-on somatic/germline variant calling and interpretation (WES/WGS/panel; MAF/VCF), copy-number and structural-variant analysis, mutational signatures, bulk and single-cell RNA-seq (cell-state annotation, subtyping), tumor-immune contexture (immune deconvolution, spatial transcriptomics, multiplex imaging), subclonal reconstruction, or functional-genomics screens (CRISPR/RNAi), or clinical research is highly preferred. Proficiency in Python and/or R: VCF/MAF parsing, single-cell analysis (Scanpy/Seurat), gene-set scoring (GSEA/ssGSEA), immune deconvolution (CIBERSORTx), subclonal reconstruction (PyClone), statistical analysis. Understanding of cancer-genomics standards: AMP/ASCO/CAP and ACMG/AMP variant tiers, ESCAT and OncoKB actionability levels, PAM50 and Consensus Molecular Subtypes, IFN-γ/T-cell-inflamed signature, consensus Immunoscore. Recognize experimental variability, and assay limitations; distinguish real biological signal from pipeline or annotation artifact. Strong written communication on technical decisions, uncertainty, and alternative interpretations. Nice-to-Have Familiarity with cancer-genomics resources and standards: TCGA/GDC, PCAWG, AACR Project GENIE, cBioPortal, OncoKB/CIViC/VICC, COSMIC signatures, HTAN, Human Cell Atlas, DepMap/Project Score, gnomAD/ClinVar, MSigDB. Breadth across multiple conclusion types like: diagnosis, mechanism, clonal evolution, immune contexture, target nomination, actionability. Prior work on benchmarks, task-based assessment, or deterministic grading. Culture @ Latch How we work. Genuinely flexible schedules - we just ask that you communicate when you're coming in later than usual. We care most about hard work and output. We're respectfully opinionated, it will always be us against problems, not each other. Optimize for each other's time and bring solutions, not just problems. You'll join a bench suited to your expertise, but we value cross-domain learning and interoperability across teams. Office & Perks. Waterfront office near Oracle Park, 2x free daily meals, unlimited snacks, company outings most months, and team offsites. Plus a vibrant community: cycling, soccer, figure skating, boxing, run clubs, reading clubs, martial arts, music, game nights. Compensation & Logistics 1099 (or W8-BEN) contract, 40 hrs/week, no end date Fully performance-based pay - OTE: $120K–$180K, uncapped upside. 2x quota = 2x pay. 2-4 week paid ramp: full OTE during ramp Remote (globally), hybrid, or onsite in SF (onsite preferred) Work authorization: OPT visa holders only (not STEM Extension) Onsite perks: 2x free meals/day, waterfront office (China Basin), monthly parking (based on availability) Candidates with all of the above qualifications + proven management skills will be eligible for more senior positions Interview Process Timeline: We move fast: 8 - 12 days from submission to offer. title: Research Associate II, Pluvinage Lab
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

We are seeking a Research Associate to join the Pluvinage Lab at the Arc Institute. Our goal is to improve the lives of patients with neurological diseases. We do this by exploring undiagnosed autoimmunity in rare mystery cases and common neurodegenerative conditions alike. Starting with clinical observations and primary patient tissue, we use functional genomics, protein display technologies, and computational tools to embark on deep mechanistic dives into the contribution of autoimmunity to cognitive function. Your work will have the potential to uncover novel autoantibodies that drive cognitive decline in autoimmune encephalitis, that modulate cognitive decline in dementia, and that promote cognitive resilience in healthy brain aging.

The questions we ask:

  1. How do autoantibodies regulate cognition?
  2. What is the source, target, and mechanism of pathogenic autoantibodies in neurological disease?
  3. How can we eliminate pathogenic autoantibodies while leaving the rest of the immune system intact?
  4. How does comorbid autoimmunity contribute to cognitive decline in neurodegeneration?
  5. Are there protective autoantibodies that promote cognitive resilience in healthy brain aging?

The approaches we take: discovery-driven projects starting with human samples (cerebrospinal fluid, PBMCs, brain tissue) from curated cohorts of patients with neurological diseases, CRISPR screens, phage display, immune repertoire sequencing.

In this role, you will work closely with senior lab members to drive high-throughput antibody discovery in autoimmune neurology and neurodegeneration. You will contribute across the full experimental workflow: designing constructs and libraries, cloning and validating reagents, executing screens across several protein display technologies, and analyzing and validating discoveries. This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys both the precision of molecular biology and the challenge of making complex discovery workflows reproducible and scalable. Your work will help advance new diagnostic approaches from bench to bedside.

About you

  • You are detail-oriented and rigorous, taking pride in well-designed experiments, reliable reagents, and reproducible results.
  • You are curious and self-motivated, with a strong foundation in molecular biology and an eagerness to learn new protein display and antibody discovery technologies.
  • You enjoy working across an entire experimental workflow, from sequence design and cloning to screening and data analysis.
  • You are organized and able to manage multiple experiments while maintaining careful sample tracking and documentation.
  • You collaborate closely with others, communicate results and challenges openly, and troubleshoot thoughtfully.
  • You are passionate about translating discoveries into better diagnostics for patients with neurological disease.
  • This position is designed as a training role for individuals preparing to apply to a PhD program. The work associated with this role is expected to last approximately two years, giving you time to build a portfolio of research to support future applications.

In this position you will

  • Build Discovery Reagents: Work with senior lab members to design DNA constructs and protein display libraries; perform molecular cloning, sequence verification, and quality control of constructs and libraries.
  • Execute High-Throughput Screens: Prepare reagents and patient samples, carry out antibody discovery and antigen-identification workflows across multiple protein display platforms, and maintain rigorous controls and sample tracking throughout.
  • Analyze and Validate Discoveries: Process screening data using established analysis workflows, assess data quality and reproducibility, and work with senior lab members to prioritize hits and validate antibody–antigen interactions using complementary assays.
  • Develop and Optimize Workflows: Work with senior lab members to troubleshoot experiments, compare assay conditions, and help improve the sensitivity, specificity, throughput, and reproducibility of discovery methods.
  • Maintain Research Quality: Keep complete experimental records, document protocols and analysis steps, and maintain organized inventories of samples, constructs, libraries, and reagents.
  • Contribute to a Collaborative Lab: Communicate progress at lab meetings, coordinate experiments with senior lab members and collaborators, and contribute to shared lab operations, equipment maintenance, and protocol training.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, immunology, genetics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant laboratory experience.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in an academic or industry setting (including independent lab work during your undergraduate studies).
  • Hands-on research experience in molecular biology
  • Demonstrated ability to execute multistep experimental protocols accurately, use appropriate controls, and maintain clear and complete laboratory records.
  • Growth mindset to stretch your scientific skillset in a supportive environment, and the awareness to know when to ask for help.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, including careful tracking of samples, reagents, and experimental conditions.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently on established workflows and collaboratively with senior scientists.
  • Commitment to rigorous, reproducible research and a strong interest in antibody discovery and its diagnostic applications.

The base salary for this position is $75,900. This amount does not include benefits or other forms of compensation.

title: Associate Product Marketing Manager (Single Cell Sequencing)
description:
WHO WE ARE

Parse Biosciences, a QIAGEN company, is a global life sciences company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. The company develops and commercializes single-cell sequencing technologies and related products used in biomedical research. Parse products are utilized in more than 3,000 laboratories worldwide and include Evercode™ Whole Transcriptome, Evercode™ TCR, Gene Capture, and associated software solutions.

Founded based on technology developed at the University of Washington, Parse operates a 34,000-square-foot headquarters and laboratory facility in Seattle’s South Lake Union district. 

THE POSITION

The Associate Product Marketing Manager will support the development and execution of product marketing initiatives that communicate the value of Parse Biosciences’ products and technologies to existing and prospective customers. This role will help create compelling, scientifically informed content and messaging across the company’s product portfolio and support new product launches and commercial initiatives.

Working closely with Product Management, Marketing, Sales, and scientific teams, this individual will help translate complex scientific and technical information into clear, engaging content for a variety of audiences. The ideal candidate brings a strong scientific foundation, excellent communication and organizational skills, and an interest in developing their product marketing expertise within the rapidly evolving field of single-cell genomics.

IN THIS POSITION, YOU WILL:

  • Support the development of product positioning, messaging, and value propositions for Parse Biosciences’ product portfolio and new product initiatives.
  • Create and coordinate content for multi-channel marketing efforts, including product collateral, presentations, web content, email campaigns, sales enablement materials, and other customer-facing resources.
  • Help tailor messaging and content to different customer segments, applications, and stages of the buyer journey.
  • Partner with Product Managers and other stakeholders to support product launches, campaigns, and ongoing commercial initiatives.
  • Assist in gathering customer, market, and competitive insights to inform messaging, content, and product marketing activities.
  • Support the development and refinement of customer personas, segmentation, customer journeys, and key messaging.
  • Coordinate the development, review, and maintenance of product marketing collateral and supporting materials.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Marketing, including Brand, Design, Digital Marketing, Communications, and other functions, to develop effective campaigns and materials.
  • Partner with Sales and customer-facing teams to understand their needs and develop tools and content that support customer engagement.
  • Help ensure product messaging and marketing materials are accurate, consistent, and aligned across channels.
  • Stay current on advances in single-cell genomics, Parse Biosciences’ technology and products, customer needs, and the broader competitive landscape.
  • Support additional product marketing projects and initiatives as the business and product portfolio continue to grow.

FOR THIS POSITION, WE LOOK FOR

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, marketing, business, or a related discipline; a scientific background is strongly preferred.
  • 1 - 3 years of relevant experience in product marketing, marketing, product management, customer/application support, or another relevant role within life sciences, biotechnology, genomics, or a related industry.
  • An interest in developing expertise in product marketing and translating complex scientific concepts into clear, compelling customer-facing communications.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with scientific and technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • A proactive and collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams and functions.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn about customers, markets, products, and emerging scientific technologies.
  • Experience with genomics, next-generation sequencing, or single-cell technologies is preferred but not required.

JOB CONDITIONS

  • This position is home office based and will require a reliable internet connection and suitable workspace to fulfill job duties effectively. Laptop and any other essential technical/home office equipment will be provided. 
  • Regular communication and collaboration with team members will occur virtually through Zoom meetings, instant messaging, and email.

Notice to applicants:

We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the @khanacademy.org domain. ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY

Khan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY KIDS

Khan Academy Kids is a free and fun learning program for children ages 2 to 8. Kodi Bear and a cast of animated characters lead children on a personalized education journey filled with fun, standards-aligned activities in early literacy, math, executive functioning and social emotional skills. Built by a small but mighty team, Khan Academy Kids is used by millions of children in homes and classrooms around the world. 

OUR COMMUNITY 

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

THE ROLE

Khan Academy Kids is looking for an early childhood educator and learning-content developer to build and strengthen learning activities and assessments for children in PreK through 2nd grade.

Working on a small, interdisciplinary team alongside product managers, engineers, designers, and academic experts, the Content Creator will identify gaps in our content library, create and revise learning experiences in English and Spanish, and improve the systems that support content development. Content spans bilingual (English and Spanish) learning activities and direct assessments across early literacy, language, math, and executive function.

We are looking for someone who understands how young children learn, is energized by using data to make content better, and cares deeply about making early learning both rigorous and fun. 

This is a fixed-term position with an expected term of 24 months.

Responsibilities:

  • Author high-quality, standards-aligned learning activities and assessment items in English and Spanish for PreK through 2nd grade, using subject-matter expertise and knowledge of early-learning standards (e.g., Head Start ELOF, Common Core, state PreK standards)
  • Map content coverage across the Khan Academy Kids library, building crosswalks that connect practice activities to assessments and identifying gaps in coverage
  • Revise and improve existing assessments based on direct child assessment data and psychometric analyses
  • Author and test new assessment items with children and educators in classroom settings
  • Learn and leverage Khan Academy Kids' content-authoring infrastructure, and partner with product and engineering to improve authoring tooling and workflows
  • Coordinate with creative teams on asset and audio requests, and improve audio-generation and quality-assurance processes
  • Serve as an editorial reviewer for new and existing content in both English and Spanish

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 2+ years of experience developing educational content or teaching, ideally with children in preschool through second grade. Experience with early childhood assessment (item development, administration, or play-testing) is a strong plus.
  • Full professional fluency and strong writing and editing skills in English and Spanish, with mindfulness of dialectal variation in both languages. Must be able to create, edit, and adapt developmentally appropriate content while preserving meaning, tone, and cultural relevance across languages. Note that Spanish proficiency will be assessed during the hiring process.
  • Experience working with early-learning standards (e.g., Head Start ELOF, Common Core, state PreK frameworks) and ensuring alignment and coverage
  • Comfort using data and learner feedback to evaluate, prioritize, and improve content
  • Comfort learning technical systems and working with structured content, including experience with or a willingness to learn JSON and SQL
  • Experience collaborating with colleagues across product, engineering, design, research, creative, and academic teams
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with close attention to detail
  • Motivated by the Khan Academy mission “to provide a free world-class education for anyone, anywhere."
  • Proven cross-cultural competency skills demonstrating self-awareness, awareness of other, and the ability to adopt inclusive perspectives, attitudes, and behaviors to drive inclusion and belonging throughout the organization.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

We may be a non-profit, but we reward our talented team extremely well! We offer:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Ample paid time off as needed – Your well-being is a priority
  • 8 pre-scheduled Wellness Days in 2026 occurring on a Monday or a Friday for a 3-day weekend boost
  • Remote-first culture - that caters to your time zone, with open flexibility as needed, at times
  • Generous parental leave
  • An exceptional team that trusts you and gives you the freedom to do your best
  • The chance to put your talents towards a deeply meaningful mission and the opportunity to work on high-impact products that are already defining the future of education
  • Opportunities to connect through affinity, ally, and social groups
  • And we offer all those other typical benefits as well: 401(k) + 4% matching & comprehensive insurance, including medical, dental, vision, and life

At Khan Academy we are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, the well-being of our employees, and our Khan community. This belief is why we have built out a robust Total Rewards package that includes competitive base salaries, and extensive benefits and perks to support physical, mental, and financial well-being.

The compensation band for this role is $77,600 - $87,300 USD annually for candidates based in the United States and $104,862 - $117,969 CAD annually for candidates based in Canada.

The pay range for this position is a general guideline only. The salary offered will depend on internal pay equity and the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, qualifications, and job market data. 

MORE ABOUT US

  • Sal’s TED talk from 2011
  • Sal’s TED talk from 2015
  • Sal's TED talk from 2023
  • Our team:  http://www.khanacademy.org/about/the-team

OUR COMPANY VALUES

Live & breathe learners

We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.

Take a stand

As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.

Embrace diverse perspectives

We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.

Work responsibly and sustainably

We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non-profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.

Bring out the joy

We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co-create with our teammates, partners and donors.

Cultivate learning mindset

We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.

Deliver wow

We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end-to-end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.

Profluent is scaling the discovery engines that supply data for AI-driven antibody and protein design. We're hiring an experienced protein engineer to lead display campaigns and build high-throughput platforms for measuring protein-protein interactions (PPI) at scale.

What You Will Contribute To Altos

 

Join Altos Labs at the Bay Area Discovery Science center and play a pivotal role in our mission to reverse brain aging. We are seeking a driven neuroscientist with deep expertise in neurodegeneration to join our highly collaborative, fast-paced team. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional experts to discover and validate optimal therapeutic targets for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. If you are passionate about translating complex biology into transformative therapies, we want you on our team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the Science: Act as the scientific lead for a key segment of our neurodegeneration portfolio. You will shape critical research questions, design robust experiments, and drive studies through to actionable, interpretable conclusions.
  • Model Disease Biology: Design and execute in vivo studies using rodent models of neurodegeneration, strategically selecting models, timepoints, and endpoints tailored to specific biological questions and program stages.
  • Analyze Complex Tissue: Process and analyze both rodent and human brain tissue. This includes dissection, regional sampling, fixation, cryopreservation, sectioning, and comprehensive downstream characterization (molecular, biochemical, and histological).
  • Innovate Quantitative Readouts: Develop and apply precise quantitative readouts for pathology and disease biology, tracking markers such as protein aggregation, neuroinflammation, cell loss, and vascular integrity.
  • Collaborate Across Disciplines: Partner closely with internal experts—including in vivo pharmacology, histology, molecular biology, computational, and program management teams—as well as external collaborators and CROs to seamlessly deliver on shared timelines.
  • Champion Scientific Rigor: Establish and promote the highest technical and cultural standards across our scientific functions. You will help embed foundational practices—such as experimental rigor, blinding, randomization, data provenance, and reproducibility—into our day-to-day operations.
  • Drive Strategic Decisions: Actively contribute to program strategy and high-level decision-making, providing critical input on go/no-go recommendations. We value transparent communication, so you will be expected to flag risks early and candidly.
  • Ensure Data Integrity: Maintain rigorous, traceable records and structured data capture, ensuring your findings can be easily reviewed, reproduced, and built upon by the wider team.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep a close pulse on the latest neurodegeneration literature and proactively bring relevant external developments to bear on our internal research programs.

Who You Are 

The level of the position will depend on the qualifications of the selected candidate.

Core Expertise & Credentials

  • Neurodegeneration Specialist: You hold a Ph.D. in Neuroscience (or a related field) backed by 1+ years of post-doctoral or industry research experience focused on neurodegeneration.
  • Disease Biology Deep-Dive: You bring a robust understanding of neurodegenerative disease biology, including a nuanced perspective on the strengths and limitations of the rodent models used to study it.
  • Proven Track Record: You have an established publication record in the field and are accustomed to presenting your findings at conferences or similar scientific venues.

Technical & Experimental Capabilities

  • Hands-on Analyst: You have extensive, practical experience processing and analyzing both rodent and human brain tissue samples.
  • In Vivo & Imaging: You have practical experience with animal surgeries, behavior, and vascular biology, and are proficient in imaging and behavioral analysis techniques.
  • Therapeutic Fluency: You have experience working with therapeutic modalities relevant to the Central Nervous System (CNS), such as AAV-based approaches, ASOs, or small molecules.
  • Data-Driven Design: You possess strong quantitative and statistical judgment, enabling you to design appropriately powered studies, analyze complex data, and interpret results objectively without over-extrapolating.
  • In Vivo & Imaging: You have practical experience with animal surgeries, behavior, and vascular biology, and are proficient in imaging and behavioral analysis techniques.

Scientific Mindset & Adaptability

  • Fiercely Independent & Rigorous: You are highly self-directed—capable of defining a problem, selecting the right approach, and driving it to a conclusion with minimal oversight. You practice rigorous critical thinking and are always willing to interrogate your own data or change your position when the evidence warrants it.
  • Thrive in Dynamic Environments: You are comfortable and composed in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment where priorities can shift, decisions carry real weight, and quality must be sustained under pressure.

Leadership & Collaboration

Preferred Qualifications, Knowledge, Skill and Abilities

ABOUT SINGULAR GENOMICS

Singular Genomics is inventing at the forefront of genomics, one of the world’s fastest-growing industries. Our Headquarters are located on the Torrey Pines Mesa, in La Jolla, California at the center of the biotech hub. Our Manufacturing facility is in Sorrento Valley.

 

Position Summary:

As an Warehouse Operator, you will be a vital member of the Supply Chain team, directly supporting instrument and consumables manufacturing operations. In this role, you serve as a primary owner of inventory accuracy, data integrity within NetSuite ERP, and material traceability.

Beyond daily cycle counting and inventory control, you will actively manage inter-site material transfers using company vehicles, support shipping/receiving operations, manage non-inventory purchasing logistics, generate assembly Work Orders, and drive strategic warehouse space optimization. You will work closely with Manufacturing, Warehousing, Planning, Procurement, and Finance to safeguard inventory precision, prevent supply disruptions, maintain a high standard of safety, and support continuous process improvements.   • Receiving & Inbound Material Handling
    • Unload incoming freight, truckloads, and container shipments safely and efficiently.
    • Inspect inbound goods against packing slips, purchase orders, and specifications to verify quantities and check for visible damage.
    • Execute system receipts and log incoming inventory accurately into the ERP system (NetSuite).
    • Stage, tag, and route received materials to appropriate stock locations, inspection areas, or production lines.
  • Order Fulfillment, Picking, & Packing
    • Review picking lists and select items accurately using standard operating procedures and RF scanners or barcode software.
    • Pick, pack, and label customer orders, kits, or internal requisitions with high attention to detail to prevent errors.
    • Stage finished shipments in designated loading zones and assist with safe loading into outbound transport vehicles.
  • Inventory Control, Site-to-Site Transfers, & Truck Runs
    • Execute systematic site-to-site inventory transfers, ensuring materials are accurately picked, staged, documented, and transacted between facilities or internal locations.
    • Conduct routine truck runs between company sites to safely deliver inventory, parts, supplies, and miscellaneous items according to scheduled routes.
    • Perform cycle counts, physical inventory counts, and location audits to maintain high stock accuracy.
    • Adhere to First Expired or FIFO stock rotation principles, monitoring lot tracking and expiration dates where applicable.
    • Process material adjustments, scrap/non-conformance disposition movements, and other inventory transactions within the system.
  • Safety, Housekeeping, & Continuous Improvement
    • Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free workspace by applying 5S methodology (Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, Sustain).
    • Operate material handling equipment (such as pallet jacks, hand trucks, and forklifts if certified) safely and inspect equipment prior to use.
    • Comply with all company safety guidelines, traffic and transport regulations, and internal standard operating procedures (SOPs).
    • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and operational reviews to streamline floor workflows.

  • Prior experience with RF-Smart and asset management systems a plus
  • Physical Requirements: Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift heavy materials (frequently up to 50 lbs) throughout a standard shift.
  • Core Competencies: Strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving skills, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Certifications: Forklift certification or willingness to obtain one is a plus.

Khan Academy is seeking an experienced and versatile assessment content creator to serve as an Elementary ELA Content Creator on the Assessments team.  This is a fixed-term position with an expected term of 24 months. As an assessment content creator, you  will contribute to the development of new, innovative K-12 assessments. The ideal candidates will possess deep knowledge of  grade 3 - 5 ELA, state standards, and assessment development best practices, and have a passion for teaching and learning. 

Our ELA assessments content team of middle school and high school ELA content creators work closely together as a team to optimize standards coherence and alignment, and work cross-functionally with engineers, designers, and other teams at Khan Academy whose close collaboration is essential to delivering a high-quality, equitable, engaging  assessment experience for all learners.

  • Use and contribute to improvements in our content and item management systems
  • Ensure alignment of items with state standards and  item development best practices
  • Collaborate with teammates and cross-functional teams - product, design, and engineering -to create more engaging,  interactive, and informative assessments for our students

title: Scientist- Delivery Sciences-targeted LNPs (tLNPs)
description:
Company info

NewLimit is a biotechnology company working to radically extend human healthspan. We’re developing medicines to treat aging by reprogramming the epigenome, a new therapeutic mechanism to restore youthful function in aged cells. We’ve built the world’s leading experimental and artificial intelligence system to discover reprogramming medicines at massive scale. Our first products are focused on restoring youthful metabolic, endothelial, and immune function.

Description

NewLimit is seeking a Scientist to design, formulate and characterize targeted LNPs (tLNPs) with antibody conjugates, Nanobodies, and scFv’s to build our targeting LNP platform with a particular focus on getting nucleic acid payloads into target cells and tissues beyond the liver.

This is a hands-on bench role with targeting compositional and reaction design ownership. You will work closely with the Delivery Sciences and biology teams to design and build relevant targeting lipids portfolio for New Limit’s pipeline programs.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop LNP compositions and conjugation chemistries for antibodies, nanobodies, scFv’s, peptides, and other targeting moieties across multiple structural families, pushing the platform beyond current-generation materials for extra-hepatic targeting.
  • Plan conjugation reactions and purification for these modalities with scale and final purity in mind from the outset, delivering against agreed project timelines.
  • Test targeting lipids for the tLNP platform using an SAR-based approach to guide the next design cycle.
  • Develop conjugation chemistries in-house or work with external partners to get the targeted LNPs for a particular target cell and build processes to support research teams to test the tLNPs in vivo.
  • Turn in vitro and in vivo data from discovery teams into concrete structural hypotheses and optimize the tLNP compositions or the type of targeting molecules used.
  • Present experimental results, and SAR conclusions, authoring protocols and technical reports.

Requirements

  • PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmaceutical Chemistry and Biochemistry or a related discipline, plus 1–2 years of relevant work; or an MS with 5 years of focused tLNP design experience for liposomal or lipid nanoparticle applications.
  • Strong skill set in the design formulation of new targeted LNPs, performed personally rather than with a supervisor directing each step.
  • SAR-driven design, purification, and characterization of tLNPs and targeted moiety conjugated lipids and AI-based SAR prediction tools for tLNP applications.
  • Working knowledge of conjugation chemistries for attaching targeting moieties such as peptides, antibodies, nanobodies, and small-molecule ligands, including linker design and the selection of suitable biorthogonal or site-specific handles.
  • Practical purification skills spanning normal- and reverse-phase, size-exclusion chromatography and preparative HPLC.
  • Analytical characterization across LC-CAD, LC-UV, DLS, CE, bio-layer interferometry and surface plasmon resonance with the ability to deconvolute the data to produce well-characterized tLNPs.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with novel conjugation chemistries and reaction methods.
  • Targeting moiety optimization experience for Immune cells and endothelial cells.
  • Exposure to scale-up process development, CMC, or tech transfer to a CDMO.
  • Experience with data visualization and statistical analysis (R, Python, JMP)

Benefits

NewLimit provides generous benefits so our team can remain focused on our mission:

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision insurance.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Industry-leading PTO: 20 days per year plus holidays.
  • On-site meals and snacks.

Salary Range: $130,000 to $171,000. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. NewLimit offers a competitive benefits package, which includes a 401k, healthcare coverage, and 20 days of PTO. Shift: Monday-Friday, 7:30/8am start time

Foresight Diagnostics is a molecular diagnostics company pioneering non-invasive cancer detection through highly sensitive, cell-free DNA-based liquid biopsy technologies. Our proprietary methods - originally developed at Stanford University - are designed to detect smaller tumors earlier and enable more personalized treatment strategies for patients with cancer. 

We sit at the intersection of molecular biology, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS), and we translate rigorous science into clinically meaningful solutions. Following our acquisition by Natera, we now combine the agility of a mission-driven startup with the scale and resources of a global leader in cell-free DNA testing. It’s an exciting moment to join us. 

Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, our team operates in a high accountability, collaborative environment where quality and continuous improvement aren’t just values - they’re how we work every day.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Lab Automation Engineer at Foresight Diagnostics will be responsible for supporting the development and continuous improvement of Foresight’s laboratory automation function as well as providing first line support for troubleshooting methods in the CLIA lab. As the business life cycle evolves to vertically integrate manufacturing, this role will support the development and implementation with transition to the tech transfer functions within the organization. This position will collaborate cross functionally to deliver on business objectives with the intention of cross functional integration and operational scaling. This is a full-time position working 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM Monday to Friday, but may require the flexibility to work diverse schedules, including weekends, and holidays.  

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Effectively deliver to project deadlines, on time and on budget, with adherence to applicable quality and regulatory requirements. 
  • Iterate on processes to drive continuous improvement with prioritization managed through the application/interpretation of KPI results. 
  • Collaborate with laboratory leads to align on automation requirements and develop workflows and instrument methods for laboratory optimization and software integration. 
  • Regularly perform preventative maintenance and inspections on Foresight’s automated systems to ensure reliable functionality. 
  • Execute major and minor repairs or coordinate with vendors for more complex repairs. 
  • Collaborate with Laboratory Operations to develop SOPs and training programs to enable successful tech transfer of new technology/workflows to the laboratory teams for production use. 
  • Work cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, and laboratory teams as necessary to properly forecast the number of automation instrumentation needed to meet volume demand, plan for and propose upgrades to the Foresight’s automation solution. 
  • As needed, perform maintenance to ensure operational capacity never impacts Foresight’s ability to successfully deliver on time results.  
  • Ensure effective resource utilization, planning and execution of people, process, and products in alignment with corporate objectives and volume projections across cross-functional teams. 
  • Implement laboratory processes that are compliant with appropriate regulations, to include but not limited to GxP, ISO, CFR, CAP/CLIA, NYSDOH. 
  • Guide troubleshooting and resolution of incident reports and CAPAs while driving continuous improvement

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years engineering experience supporting laboratory environments. 
  • A bachelor’s degree: BA/BS. An advanced degree, such as a Ph.D. or Masters degree preferred. 
  • Additional technical training would be a plus with an understanding of molecular biology and genomics. 
  • Working knowledge of liquid handling platforms such as Hamilton STAR line and Agilent Bravo preferred 
  • Proven ability to deliver actionable results to complex problems. 
  • Strong organizational skills with an understanding of scaling and capacity planning. 
  • Advanced analytical and operational skills with an ability to identify meaningful insights from complex data. 
  • Self-starter who thrives in ambiguity in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Ability to deliver on end-to-end projects with a high level of autonomy. 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • This position requires the individual to wear and work in personal protective equipment. 
  • This position requires that the individual is able to lift a minimum of 25lbs. 
  • Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers are required. 
  • The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures, writing and reviewing documents, and pipetting small volumes of clear liquids. 

Compensation & Total Rewards 

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Every program we run across maternity, fertility, menopause, and pediatrics, depends on it. It's where clinical workflows, provider tooling, and the systems that make care measurable, billable, and scalable at Maven's scale all come together.

We're looking for a Product Manager to help build that platform: the EHR and clinical tooling, provider workflows, messaging, and the data and billing infrastructure that turn Maven's care model into something reliable and scalable. You'll own defined capabilities within the platform and drive them from problem to shipped, in close partnership with engineering, clinical, design, and operations. It's a high-leverage seat. You'll report to the Group Product Manager, Care Delivery, and work closely with our providers, as well as Clinical Product, Member Experience, Operations, and the Data and AI Platform teams.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own specific Care Delivery capabilities end-to-end, provider workflows, clinical documentation, messaging, scheduling and matching, or quality and billing infrastructure, from problem definition through launch and iteration.
  • Make crisp, well-reasoned product decisions, especially where clinical accuracy and provider experience are both at stake.
  • Use AI hands-on to move faster, prototyping with AI tools to test ideas and pressure-test flows before committing engineering time, and identify and build AI-powered capabilities into the care delivery platform where they genuinely improve the provider or member experience.
  • Partner daily with engineering and design to ship reliable platform capabilities, and with clinical and operations partners so that what you build works for real providers and members.

description:
Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need

We are seeking an Alliance Partner Manager to lead the technical dimension of our alliances and partnering function for Luma, our AI-Native Multimodal Research Platform for Scientific Intelligence. Sitting at the intersection of business and engineering, you'll own how our platform connects with, integrates into, and creates value alongside the products of our strategic technology partners, such as Databricks and AWS.

This position is based in EMEA, working globally across time zones, with potential future expansion of channel partnerships into NAM. It is a senior role with broad scope, where you'll act as the bridge between partner engineering teams and our own product, engineering and commercial organizations, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales, as well as colleagues at Siemens, with room to design and build the technical alliance capability around you.

While the focus is strategic, this remains a hands-on role: you'll need enough technical depth to scope integrations credibly, validate them in sandboxes, and hold your own in a conversation with a partner's engineering team. We're looking for someone with an engineering-minded, "application scientist" type approach — comfortable understanding the technical requirements involved in onboarding a partner, and operating confidently within a large company mindset and environment.

In this role you will get to:

  • Define, build, and execute the technical partner strategy, prioritising which integrations and joint solutions to build, developing and implementing joint go-to-market plans (co-sell, co-build, co-deliver), aligning teams and facilitating sales enablement and training of partners.
  • Own engineering level relationships across partner organisations through effective communication, structured governance and business reviews, and joint business planning.
  • Scope integration feasibility early in partner conversations, translating vague partner asks into clear, buildable technical specifications and setting realistic expectations.
  • Oversee solution architecture, use-case mapping, partner product certification and sandbox / proof-of-concept development to design and validate joint solutions.
  • Engage partners to develop differentiated solutions through joint collaboration, market and competitive analysis, and the creation of joint marketing collateral.
  • Evangelise partnerships internally, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales stakeholders, and with colleagues at Siemens, feeding partner needs into the roadmap and organising collaborative events.
  • Define, track and analyse key partnership metrics, collaborating with partners to optimise performance, and represent Dotmatics/Siemens at alliance and partner conferences and events.
  • Focus specifically on systems integration partners, bringing on partners that will meaningfully increase the bottom line.

We are looking for candidate's who have 7+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, solution architecture or pre-sales engineering, including several years leading strategic technical partner or ISV relationships at enterprise scale. You've built integrations, not just managed them, and you can move fluently between a business review and a whiteboard session with a partner's engineers. You're comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy on complex, ambiguous pursuits, and you set realistic expectations that engineering can actually deliver on.

Just as importantly, you lead through influence. You can align engineering, marketing and sales teams, internally and across partner organisations, behind a shared plan without direct authority, and you're motivated by building a partnering function and team, not just running one. While not a traditional "sales" person, you're comfortable navigating sales-style conversations, combining technical knowledge with strong relationship management and communication skills.

Key Skills:

  • Technical partnership leadership - a proven track record defining and executing partner or alliance strategy with ISVs, technology platforms or system integrators, with measurable partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue impact.
  • Hands-on integration fluency, including practical depth with APIs, authentication and data-exchange patterns, and the ability to scope, spec and validate integrations through sandboxes and proof-of-concept builds.
  • Joint go-to-market execution - experience developing co-sell, co-build and co-deliver plans, aligning internal and partner teams, facilitating sales enablement and creating the collateral that makes joint solutions land.
  • Executive-level relationship management - comfort owning senior stakeholder relationships across partner organisations, running structured business reviews (QBRs), and resolving conflict constructively when internal and partner priorities clash.
  • Data-driven partner management, with the habit of defining, tracking and analysing partnership KPIs and leading indicators of partner health and acting on them before issues escalate.

You may also have:

  • Experience with cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) or OEM / embedded partnership motions.
  • Experience structuring and negotiating complex commercial and technical agreements alongside legal teams.
  • Familiarity with tiered partner certification programmes.
  • A background or interest in scientific, life-sciences or research software, or another domain-deep industry such as Oil & Gas or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG).

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. 

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

Real Chemistry is seeking an AI Transformation Analyst to help reimagine how our business runs. You will join our transformation team, working alongside ambitious, supportive, and hard-working colleagues who always seek to do things better, faster, and smarter.

As an AI Transformation Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in mapping how work gets done today and designing how it should get done in an AI-enabled future. Starting with our General & Administrative (G&A) functions, including finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, and internal communications, you will document current-state processes and operating models, design future-state alternatives, and help bring them to life across several AI transformation initiatives. You will also build the business case for each opportunity and prioritize initiatives based on the value they deliver. You will look holistically across people, processes, systems, and vendors to determine what should be automated or redesigned and which solution best fits each need, from a reusable AI skill to an end-to-end Copilot Cowork workflow or a coordinated team of AI agents. This position reports to the Vice President, Strategy and Revenue Analytics.

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

What you'll do:

  • Map current-state processes: Lead process discovery with G&A stakeholders across finance, accounting, operations, resource management, marketing, legal, internal communications, and more to document how work gets done today, including handoffs, systems, data flows, vendors, pain points, and the time and cost behind each step.
  • Design future-state operating models: Translate current-state findings into practical future-state designs that rethink roles, responsibilities, governance, and ways of working, rather than simply digitizing today's processes.
  • Identify and prioritize automation opportunities: Assess where AI and automation can eliminate, streamline, or augment manual work, build business cases that size the impact, and shape a prioritized transformation roadmap.
  • Match the right solution to the problem: Determine the right fit for each need, whether a reusable AI skill, a Copilot Cowork workflow, a coordinated swarm of AI agents, an enhancement to an existing system, or a process change with no new technology at all, and partner with technical teams to pilot and scale solutions.
  • Get more from current automations: Inventory and assess the automations and tools already in place, identify gaps and redundancies, and recommend how to extract more value from existing investments.
  • Rethink sourcing and vendors: Analyze what we outsource versus perform in-house, assess vendor fit and cost, and determine where AI enablement means outsourced work should instead be automated or brought in-house.
  • Drive change and adoption: Partner with function leaders to plan and execute transitions, including change management, training, communications, and success measures that make new ways of working stick.
  • Advise leadership: Develop clear, executive-ready materials, including process maps, operating model blueprints, business cases, and roadmaps, and communicate findings and recommendations with clarity and confidence.

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if you:

  • Think like a consultant and act like an owner, bringing structured problem solving and a bias for action to ambiguous, cross-functional challenges.
  • Are energized by rethinking traditional processes for the age of AI, and stay curious about emerging tools, agents, and automation approaches.
  • See the whole picture across people, processes, systems, vendors, and data, and understand how a change in one area ripples through the others.
  • Are highly organized, proactive, and resourceful, adept at managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment while delivering results under tight deadlines.
  • Build trust quickly with stakeholders at every level, from individual contributors to senior leadership, and can guide teams confidently through change.

What you should have:

  • 2–5 years of experience in strategy, transformation, or digital consulting (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain, EY-Parthenon, Deloitte Digital, or similar firms, large or boutique), or in a corporate strategy, transformation, or M&A integration role.
  • Hands-on experience with transformation work, such as digital transformation, M&A integration, acquisitions, or divestitures, including process mapping, integration or separation planning, Day 1 readiness, or operating model design.
  • Demonstrated experience mapping current- and future-state processes and designing target operating models, ideally across G&A or back-office functions.
  • Working knowledge of AI and automation tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, generative AI assistants, AI agents, workflow automation platforms such as Power Automate or Workato, or RPA) and the ability to translate business needs into practical automation use cases.
  • Proficiency with process mapping and analysis tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Exceptional analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings simply and confidently to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • PR, communications, advertising, healthcare, or agency experience a plus.

title: Lead Medical Writer - Medical Communications
description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. 

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. 

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.  

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.


Location: Flexible, remote or hybrid, US or Toronto (East Coast TZ)
 
About the role
 
As a Lead Medical Writer, you will take ownership of delivering high-quality, scientifically accurate content across a range of Oncology focused medical communications projects (congress activities, manuscripts, abstracts, posters, plain language summaries) transforming complex data into clear, engaging stories for healthcare professionals. You will lead multiple accounts, ensuring editorial excellence from initial planning through to final review. You will guide and support writers, manage content allocation, and play an active role in strategic client interactions. You will benefit from a clear, structured career pathway, with the opportunity to progress to Associate Scientific Director and beyond as you continue to expand your scientific, strategic and leadership skills. Your expertise will be key to maintaining high quality standards and driving successful outcomes for our clients.
 What we can offer You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August. Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business. We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Project Manager, Medical Affairs
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is looking for a Project Manager to join our growing Medical Affairs team!  

The Project Manager is responsible for delivering assigned medical affairs projects from initiation through final closeout, including planning, coordination, budget management, routing, approvals, and launch of project deliverables. Projects may include slide decks, print projects, congress materials, advisory board materials, scientific communications, and smaller digital initiatives. This role serves as a main point of contact across internal and external teams, partnering closely with Account, Scientific/Medical, Editorial, Creative, Studio, Print Production, User Experience, Technology, and Quality Assurance partners to keep work on time, on budget, and aligned to client expectations.

Whether it’s bringing in the right resources at the right time, aligning priorities with the account team, or identifying bottlenecks and proposing solutions early, no two days are the same.  

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago or Indianapolis—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. This role will primarily work Eastern business hours.

What you’ll do:  

  • Clearly communicate expectations to internal teams and vendors to support the efficient flow of work throughout the agency.
  • Partner with key agency teams to ensure projects stay on track and agreed-upon milestones are met, including Account, Scientific/Medical, Editorial, Creative, Studio, Print Production, Strategic Planning, Information UX, Technology, and Programming teams.
  • Plan, schedule, and monitor work to meet timeline, budget, and quality goals in accordance with relevant guidelines. 
  • Collaborate with finance and accounting teams on revenue recognition/invoicing processes 
  • Participate in client and stakeholder meetings as needed, with a clear understanding of project status and timelines to respond to relevant questions and provide project updates when appropriate.
  • Perform risk planning and mitigation to minimize project risk. 
  • Help create service or departmental standard operating procedures 
  • Route deliverables to appropriate core team members for review and signoff via the electronic project routing system.  
  • Ensure signoff prior to key milestones, including core team review, medical/scientific review, client review, vendor handoff, and final release.
  • Develop detailed work plans, schedules, and status reports to keep internal teams, clients, and external partners aligned throughout the project life cycle. 
  • Serve as a day-to-day project lead, helping define scope and objectives while motivating cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget. 
  • Coordinate project deliverables from concept through delivery, ensuring the appropriate internal departments, reviews, approvals, and handoffs are engaged at each stage. 
  • Support adherence to agency process and manage the quality assurance phase for all projects.

This position is a perfect fit for you if:  

  • Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.
  • You are a highly organized self-starter who can work independently and manage tight deadlines.

What you should have:  

  • 3+ years of Project/Program Management or relevant experience. 
  • 2+ years of experience in budget management. 
  • Working familiarity with industry-specific processes, including medical, legal, regulatory, and client review.
  • Background working on teams focused on medical affairs, scientific communications, medical education, or related non-promotional healthcare communications projects.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading small- to medium-scale projects from conception through completion. 
  • Experience working cross-functionally with medical/scientific, editorial, account, creative, and project management partners to deliver high-quality products and services. 
  • Proficient in creating timelines and tracking progress against schedules.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely with technical and non-technical teams across multiple business areas; excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

 Pay Range: $70,000-$85,000

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting.  Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, skills, certifications, and geographical location. The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time.

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
