  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

About the Role: 

Maven is looking for an experienced Product Marketing Manager to join Maven’s GTM Narrative Team. In this role, you will help drive the company’s future growth path, informing prioritization of new markets and executing on the GTM vision, helping Maven deliver high quality health care in new ways (fertility, maternity, parenting, and pediatrics). In this role you will help define and execute the strategy Maven’s key market segments and channels. You will lead the development of our sales playbooks for new and existing sales verticals. As part of the Product Marketing team, you will collaborate with the Sales and Demand Generation teams to build targeted campaigns, craft impactful sales content, and co-develop engaging enablement content that educates and expands access to high quality health care.

What You’ll Do:

  • Partner with Product Management to validate future product and feature concepts through customer interviews, research and analysis of user data, and convey net new features and functionality needs to effectively sell Maven’s solution into key markets and audiences.
  • Lead product launches end-to-end — positioning, messaging, launch assets, tiering, and cross-functional coordination with Product, Clinical, Sales, and other Marketing teams
  • Develop and maintain sales presentations, playbooks, battlecards, one-pagers, case studies, and other customer-facing materials
  • Build and maintain payer-, employer-, and partner-facing collateral that supports commercial conversations across prospects and existing clients
  • Lead enablement sessions for our Sales Team and our entire Go-to-Market Team on new marketing and sales materials.
  • Support RFP and proposal processes by contributing messaging, content, and subject matter expertise across product lines
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for ad hoc sales deal support, and occasional renewal/QBR support
  • Contribute to evolving Maven's core narrative and messaging, including supporting message-testing initiatives
  • Evangelize our solutions at conferences, trade shows, to analysts, prospective customers, and channel partners.

What You’ll Bring: 

  • 4+ years of experience in product marketing with preference given to sales enablement or product strategy experience
  • Proven success in driving all stage of the sales process
  • Demonstrated success and passion for collecting and using customer insight to drive strategic decisions
  • Experience inspiring, influencing and effectively communicating with others
  • Strong presentation skills with an eye towards design
  • Has an Entrepreneurial spirit and approach to work 
  • Experience partnering closely with C-Suite executives on storytelling for public speaking opportunities.
  • Ability to position innovative products and tell compelling stories through sales narratives and marketing collateral.
  • Comfortable with data, and collecting and analyzing data from a number of sources
  • Business development experience a plus
  • Experience in HealthTech or WorkTech is a plus

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week  (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. About the team

You'll be joining the Finance Operational Excellence team, reporting to the Head of Finance Operational Excellence. We are finance transformation and AI experts working side-by-side with Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to redefine processes and build the finance organization of the future. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working across disciplines: part solution developer, part data architect, part workflow designer, and part coach. You’ll have room to shape how applied AI is built and scaled both from a technical and end-user perspective.

What you’ll do

You'll work side-by-side with Finance subject matter experts to understand how work gets done, identify the highest impact opportunities, and partner with domain teams to chart a transformation plan which balances future ambitions with rapid impact.  You'll work independently to automate manual processes, design and build agents and required data solutions using internal platforms, and enable Finance teams to maintain these solutions long-term. 

You’ll build with your partner teams, not simply deliver solutions to them. You’ll help colleagues move from a manual workflow, to a first AI-enabled win, to a reliable solution they can confidently operate and improve themselves. Success means the workflow stays transformed after the initial build, the team trusts the output, and the people closest to the process can own what comes next. 

You’ll favor learning through building. When possible, you’ll put a useful prototype in front of a Finance user, test it against a real deliverable, and improve it quickly rather than spend weeks describing a theoretical future state. When you encounter platform limitations—which you will—you’ll find creative, supportable approaches, collaborate with Engineering to scope and test custom tools, and escalate strategically when needed.

This role requires a blend of process automation, data operations, technical problem-solving, and stakeholder enablement. You'll spend your time building agents, optimizing data pipelines that feed them, creating knowledge layers that make them more accurate, and training Finance teams to use and maintain them. Success means Finance teams can independently run agents you've built while you provide light support and focus on the next automation opportunity.

Responsibilities

  • Establish monitoring and observability for deployed agents, including metrics, alerting, and incident-response processes that support reliable operation.
  • Diagnose technical and data issues, resolve problems independently where possible, and collaborate with Engineering when solutions require deeper platform changes.
  • Measure adoption and impact, share lessons and wins, and turn successful implementations into standards, components, and playbooks for the broader Finance AI portfolio.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, technical operations, business intelligence, automation, solutions delivery, or a related field.
  • Of which, 2+ years of experience in program management, working directly alongside business leaders to develop and execute process transformation programs
  • Hands-on experience building AI-enabled tools, agents, automations, or workflows that changed a real business process—not solely using AI as a conversational tool, 
  • Strong SQL proficiency, including experience writing complex queries using CTEs, window functions, and joins for data analysis, transformation, or pipeline logic.
  • A track record of independently scoping and delivering technical solutions for process improvement, demonstrating ownership from problem definition through adoption.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, including the ability to identify root causes, debug complex data problems, and resolve inconsistencies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and work effectively with domain experts and Engineering partners.
  • Experience teaching, coaching, enabling users, or transferring ownership of a solution through documentation, training, or self-service tools.
  • Working knowledge of development practices such as version control, testing, code review, and iterative delivery.
  • Experience using low-code tools, scripting, workflow automation, AI-assisted development, or custom integrations, paired with curiosity and the ability to learn evolving technologies.

You will also likely have (not required):

  • Domain experience in Finance Operations, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Payments, or other areas.
  • Familiarity with modern data tools and practices, such as Python, Databricks, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data-quality controls.
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol or another extensibility or integration framework.
  • Experience navigating financial systems and understanding how data flows through accounting, reporting, reconciliation, forecasting, or payments processes.

  • Experience building internal tools, templates, components, or playbooks that were adopted beyond the original team or use case.

Note on technical depth: This role involves working at the intersection of no-code AI tools and custom development. While software engineering expertise is not required, you should be comfortable applying technical concepts, collaborating closely with Engineering teams, and using AI-assisted development tools to extend platform capabilities when needed.

Support experimentation by modelling assignment and outcome data into structured formats that analysts and PMs can query directly. Define and document metrics in our semantic layer, ensuring a single authoritative definition so downstream BI tools and AI applications yield consistent answers. Apply AI-augmented data modelling practices as a standard part of how you write, review, and migrate code. Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to turn one-off questions into durable, reusable data models. Maintain data quality in your domain through dbt tests, freshness SLAs, and proactive monitoring. What you bring Solid SQL and dbt experience, with a clear comfort owning models end to end. Clear communication skills to explain data definitions and structures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Our Business Consulting team is focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers. We are hiring recent university graduates to grow the next generation of consultants through our Business Consultant Development Program (BCDP).

About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. 

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. 

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.  

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.
 What we can offer You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August. Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business. We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Analytics Engineer, Revenue, Purchase & Order
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Revenue, Purchase & Order Analytics Engineering team.

The area sits at the heart of some of the most critical customer journeys and commercial systems across Vinted’s Marketplace Business Unit, spanning Revenue (pricing and advertising), Purchase (inquiries and checkout), and Orders (transactions and fulfilment). Together, these domains create a rich, high-volume, and deeply interconnected data ecosystem.

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of data, engineering, and product, building trusted data products that power business and product decision-making across these domains.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Build scalable data products: Design, develop, and evolve reliable, cost-efficient data products and pipelines that power analytics and machine learning use cases across the domains.
  • Build quality in by design: Embed automated testing, validation, and quality controls throughout the data lifecycle to ensure data remains accurate, consistent, and complete.
  • Strengthen observability: Improve monitoring and alerting to detect and address issues before they impact downstream consumers.
  • Own production reliability: Take end-to-end ownership of production data systems, from investigating incidents and diagnosing root causes to implementing durable fixes that prevent recurrence and improve long-term resilience.

Who you’ll work with:

  • Revenue, Purchase & Order Analytics Engineering: Join a talented and driven team of 7+ Analytics Engineers, working across interconnected domains and tackling complex, high-impact data challenges.
  • Data & Decision Scientists: Work closely with Data Scientists and Decision Scientists to build trusted data foundations that enable better business and product decisions.
  • Engineering, Product & Business: Partner with Backend Engineering, Product, and Business teams to understand their needs, shape technical requirements, and translate them into well-designed, trusted data solutions.
  • The Analytics Engineering Guild: Be an active member of Vinted’s 40+ member AE Guild, benefiting from shared tooling, engineering standards, and knowledge across domains. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to “side quests” that improve engineering practices, tooling, and reusable capabilities.

About you 

  • Experience working as an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or in a closely related data role.
  • Strong SQL and data warehousing fundamentals, with the ability to build clean, performant, and maintainable data solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt or a similar data transformation framework, building well-structured and tested data models.
  • Experience working with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar.
  • A solid understanding of data modelling principles and their application to real-world analytical problems.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar.
  • Comfortable working with high-volume, business-critical data, balancing a high bar for quality and reliability with a pragmatic bias for action.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day

title: Client Enablement & Coaching Lead (F/H/X)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills. You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio. When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt. Key Responsibilities: what you'll do Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement: Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme. Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation. Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions. Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation. Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations. Project Management: Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised. Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track. Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs. Mentorship & Coaching: Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation. Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct. Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes. Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations. Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration. Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality. Driving Organisational Change: Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach. Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success. Skills: what you'll have Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions. Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies

title: Informatikpraktikum E-Commerce im Verlag () (Front/Backend)
description: Wir sind ein erfolgreicher Fachbuch- und Hörmedienverlag im Bereich Alternativ-Medizin mit Sitz in Berlin. Gerade als kleinerer Verlag bieten wir einen umfassenden Einblick in die täglichen Abläufe sämtlicher Bereiche einer dynamisch wachsenden Verlagsarbeit, mit vielseitigen Möglichkeiten zur eigenständigen, aktiven und kreativen Betätigung in einem auch für Anfänger noch überschaubaren IT-System! Unser Firmensitz (Büro) und Ihr Praktikumsplatz befinden sich in mitten Berlin, zentral gelegen im Bezirk Friedrichshain, der bei jungen Menschen sehr beliebt ist. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind ganz in der Nähe, somit ist unser Büro leicht zu erreichen. Möglich bei uns sind 3- bis 6-monatige Pflichtpraktika. Freiwillige Praktika sind aufgrund der engen gesetzlichen Bestimmungen nur ausbildungsbegleitende denkbar, sofern noch keine abgeschlossene Ausbildung vorhanden ist. Bei unserem Praktikum können Sie - je nach Ihren Befähigungen und Neigungen - bei der Entwicklung ein neuen Shopsystems als Entwickler mitwirken. Somit bringen Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen nicht nur - wie bei vielen großen Firmen - in ein kleinteilig fraktioniertes Projekt ein, sondern können umfassend eigenständig tätig werden, mit großem gestalterischen und kreativen Freiraum. Meist sind bei uns noch 2-3 weitere Praktikant*innen aktiv, so dass Sie Teil eines kleinen netten Praktikantenteams sind, das sich auch gegenseitig unterstützen kann. Ausländische Bewerber sind willkommen. Foreign applicants are very welcome. German language is NOT necessarily required. Tasks Tätigkeiten, Herausforderungen & Aufgaben während Ihres Praktikums: Migration eines bestehenden SHOPWARE 5.7x Webshops (E-Commerce) auf die jüngste Version der neuen SHOPWARE Architektur 6.x Verwendete Sprachen/Datenbanken: PHP, MySQL, XML, HTML, CSS, JS, Twig Dieses Praktikum gibt Ihnen einen vollständigen Einblick in einen modernen Webshop und die zugrunde liegende Software-Architektur und bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, auf allen Ebenen (Backend und/oder Frontend) kreativ tätig zu sein. Sie können sich an der Migration unseres SHOPWARE-Webshops beteiligen, eigene Module entwickeln und bestehende modifizieren. Nach einer Einarbeitungs-, Trainings- und Nachschulungsphase (wo nötig) können Sie selbst kreativ und eigenständig produktive Beiträge leisten: Entwicklung eigener Plugins bzw. Erweiterungen ("Extensions") sowie Modifizierung bzw. Übertragung vorhandener Extensions in funktionaler Anpassung an die heutige Shopware-6.x-Architektur Freie Entwicklung weiterer nützlicher zukünftiger Funktionalitäten (zusätzliche Features, unabhängige Plugins) Testen von Plugins, die auf dem Markt (Community) verfügbar sind Bei Interesse ist auch die Neugestaltung von Frontend-Themes (Frontend) möglich Optimierung von Anpassungen auf anderen Geräten (Reaktionsfähigkeit, Verbesserung der Skalierbarkeit) Modifizierung und/oder Neugestaltung von Frontend-Themes (bei Interesse an Webdesign) Konzeption von Schnittstellen zwischen interner Verlagssoftware und Webshop Optional besteht bei Bedarf Ihrerseits bei uns die Möglichkeit, ein Projekt bei uns als Ihre Studien/Ausbildungs-Facharbeit (z. B. Bachelorarbeit, Masterarbeit o. ä.) zu realisieren. Requirements ALLGEMEINE VORAUSSETZUNGEN Sie haben ein freundliches Auftreten und eine positive Lebenseinstellung, sind ehrlich, offen und kontaktfreudig Sie arbeiten eigenständig, sorgfältig, engagiert, selbstständig, überlegt und strukturiert und können Eigeninitiative entwickeln Sie sind in der Lage, sich in die Erfordernisse eines komplementärmedizinischen Verlags hineinzudenken und haben Lust, sich in diesem Bereich zu betätigen. SPEZIELLE VORAUSSETZUNGEN FÜR DIESES PRAKTIKUM: Einschlägiges Studium mit IT/ E-Commerce-Affinität, idealerweise eines IT-nahen Faches wie Informatik, Medieninformatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik und/oder Aus- oder eigene Weiterbildung als Webdesigner, Systembetreuer oder Programmierer. Solide Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in PHP, MySQL, JS, XML, HTML, CSS. Sie haben bereits komplexere Projekte absolviert, die PHP und JS beinhalten und können diese auch nachweisen (bitte über den Bewerben-Button einreichen). Sicherheit im Umgang mit MySQL Datenbanken Erfahrungen in der Frontend- und Backend-Webprogrammierung Grundkenntnisse in gängigen Ecommerce-Architekturen wie Shopware oder XT-Commerce wären zusätzlich von Vorteil, sind aber keine Vorbedingung. Benefits Sie können umfassend eigenständig tätig werden, mit großem gestalterischen und kreativen Freiraum. Und Sie lernen das Shopware-System auf allen Ebenen (Frontend, Backend, Developer) umfassend kennen. Sie bekommen Ihre eigenen Testserver als Übungs- und Entwicklungsfläche und können sich dort frei betätigen. Bei Abschluss des Praktikums erhalten Sie ein detailliertes, qualifiziertes Praktikumszeugnis, das sich als Sprungbrett in größere E-Commerce-Firmen bzw. IT-Agenturen erwiesen hat. Bei entsprechendem Einsatz können Sie durch das Praktikum zu einem Shopware-Experten werden, da Sie bei uns das gesamte Webshop-System kennenlernen und nicht nur einen kleinen Ausschnitt. Vergütung: Als kleiner Betrieb können wir in der Regel (insbesondere bei noch geringen Programmierkenntnissen) keine Praktikumsvergütung leisten. Bei sehr guten Vorkenntnissen ist während der Produktivphase in gewissem Rahmen eine finanzielle Bonierung denkbar. Bitte bewerben Sie sich über den Button auf dieser Seite. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung und stehen für Fragen gerne zur Verfügung! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Corporate Marketing Operations Manager
description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. 

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. 

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.  

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

The Operations Manager is part of Avalere Health’s Corporate Marketing Team, which is responsible for developing and delivering the corporate brand, thought leadership, PR, and integrated marketing activity. The role partners closely with digital specialists to ensure the platforms, systems, and data underpinning integrated campaigns operate reliably and efficiently, supporting increased awareness, strengthened reputation, and commercial opportunities. 
Reporting to the Associate Director of Corporate Marketing, this role is accountable for the operational infrastructure that enables the wider team to deliver against the marketing goals of the Group corporate brand, as well as Avalere Health's three capabilities – Advisory, Medical, and Marketing. 
The role is central to the effective functioning of Corporate Marketing, providing the team with the platform integration, resourcing visibility and performance insight required to plan and deliver on strategic goals with confidence.
 
What You'll Do
Operational excellence and process management 
Develop a culture and processes of operational excellence within the Corporate Marketing team, leading on all Corporate Marketing process development and implementation. 


 What we can offer You'll receive up to a 7% pension contribution, life insurance, income protection, and private medical insurance for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including flexible hybrid working, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 25 days of annual leave plus two personal well-being days, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August. Access free counselling through our employee assistance program, as well as personalized health support. Enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey, as well as on-demand support from our partner Peppy. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business. We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Manager, Human Resources Operations, Japan
description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Revolution Medicines is seeking a Manager, Human Resources (HR) Operations, Japan to lead the delivery of reliable, consistent, and efficient employee services and HR processes. This people-manager role oversees the day-to-day work of the HR Operations team, translates functional plans into scalable workflows, and resolves operational issues across the employee lifecycle. Reporting to the Director, Human Rescources, Japan, the manager partners closely with HR, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Compliance, IT and other key stakeholders to deliver timely, accurate, and compliant HR services (dotted line reporting to the Senior Director, People Operations and Technology in the US).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead employee lifecycle operations, including onboarding, employee changes, leave coordination, and offboarding, and ensure accurate and timely service.

  • Translate HR policies and functional priorities into documented procedures, controls, service standards, and teamwork plans.

  • Manage HR information system workflows, data quality, reporting, and issue resolution in partnership with HR, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Communications and IT.

  • Coordinate HR operations vendors, monitor service performance and operating expenses, and address service risks and escalations.

  • Track service metrics and employee feedback, identify recurring issues, and lead continuous improvement of HR operations processes to increase quality, compliance, efficiency, and scalability.

  • Lead the responsible use of technology, including AI and automation, to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve data quality and employee service in partnership with HR, IT, Legal, and data privacy stakeholders.

  • Represent HR Operations in cross-functional and regional or global projects by defining requirements, coordinating dependencies, managing implementation activities, and supporting adoption.

  • Set team goals, assign work, coach team members, support professional development, and reinforce accountability for service delivery.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • A minimum of six years of progressive HR operations experience, including at least two years leading employees or significant operational workstreams.

  • Strong knowledge of employee lifecycle processes, HR systems, data controls, and service delivery.

  • Working knowledge of applicable Japanese employment requirements and employee data privacy practices.

  • Experience managing operational projects, vendors, expenses, and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Strong analytical judgment, problem-solving skills, and clear written and verbal communication.

  • Native-level Japanese and business-level English proficiency, with the ability to communicate clearly with employees, leaders, vendors, and global partners.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or another regulated, high-growth environment.

  • Experience with Workday or a comparable enterprise HR platform.

  • Experience supporting multi-state or global employee populations.

title: Open sollicitatie afstudeerstage
description: Jouw impact bij Movares Wil jij graag afstuderen bij Movares? Ontdek de mogelijkheden en stuur vandaag nog een sollicitatie! Dit ga je doen bij Movares Wil jij tijdens jouw afstudeerstage werken aan een leefbaar, bereikbaar en duurzaam Nederland? Zoek jij een afstudeerstage op het gebied van (rail)infrastructuur, mobiliteit, ruimte, bouw en vastgoed, energietransitie, circulair bouwen, klimaatadaptatie, water, energie of iets anders? Wij hebben ruimte voor hbo en wo studenten van veel verschillende studies. Denk aan civiele techniek, elektrotechniek, bouwkunde, ecologie, werktuigbouwkunde, IT, toegepaste wiskunde, lucht- en ruimtevaart, industriële automatisering of besturingstechniek. Volg je een andere studie maar denk je wel iets bij te kunnen dragen, dan horen wij natuurlijk ook graag van jou! Dit ben jij bij Movares Als je afstudeert bij Movares draag je direct of indirect bij aan het oplossen van maatschappelijk belangrijke vraagstukken. Voor en met opdrachtgevers als ProRail, Rijkswaterstaat, gemeenten, provincies, netbeheerders, aannemers en private partijen bedenken we oplossingen voor de infrastructuur en mobiliteit van Nederland. Actuele thema’s zoals digitale transformatie, klimaatadaptatie, energietransitie en circulair bouwen spelen hierbij een belangrijke rol. title: Manager Operations Planning & Performance
description: Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Daarvoor moet elke schakel in onze operatie, van warehouse tot voordeur, dagelijks naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. Als Manager Operations Planning & Performance ben jij de spil tussen wat de klant bestelt en hoe wij dat logistiek waarmaken. Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien. Wat je gaat doen Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn. Je zorgt voor een strakke planning tussen Delivery, Retentie en Warehouse. Zo werkt iedereen vanuit dezelfde basis en tilt jouw scherpe blik onze processen naar een hoger niveau. Je geeft leiding aan een team van routeplanners (werkstudenten en starters). Samen zorgen jullie dagelijks voor de meest efficiënte bezorgroutes. Jouw team staat in direct contact met de bezorghubs, het warehouse en de growth afdeling om de capaciteit af te stemmen Je werkt nauw samen met teams door de hele organisatie, van Tech en Analytics tot Recruitment. Om te weten wat er speelt, ben je regelmatig te vinden waar het gebeurt: op onze bezorghubs en in het warehouse. Je stuurt op operationele KPI’s (zoals Drops per Hour en Time per Stop ) en beheert belangrijke kostenlijnen. Samen met de Regiomanager en Business Analyst Delivery blijf je ons bezorgnetwerk continu optimaliseren. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de lijn tussen ons warehouse en de hubs. Je onderhoudt de contacten met vrachtwagenvervoerders, stuurt op prestaties ( On Time ) en kosten ( Cost per Drop ) en maximaliseert de vulgraad. Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Je signaleert kansen in de operatie, maakt de impact inzichtelijk en leidt verbeterprojecten van idee tot implementatie, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van servicetijd, automatisering van planningstaken of de inrichting van ons netwerk. Je bent onderdeel van het Delivery team en rapporteert aan de Head of Delivery. Dit ben jij Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in operationele planning, logistiek of supply chain, bij voorkeur in een snelgroeiende e-commerce- of retailomgeving. Je beweegt je makkelijk door de hele organisatie, van de vloer tot het management. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en krijgt verschillende teams moeiteloos op één lijn. Je creëert draagvlak en krijgt mensen mee in een gezamenlijke aanpak, ook als je geen formele zeggenschap over ze hebt Je bent sterk met data. Je duikt zelf in de cijfers, bouwt een model of dashboard als dat nodig is, en vertaalt analyses naar concrete keuzes voor de operatie. Ervaring met SQL, BigQuery en Data Studio is een pré. Jij kijkt verder dan je eigen scope en overziet de hele keten. Je begrijpt hoe een keuze in de planning doorwerkt in het warehouse, op de weg en bij de klant, en je weet de juiste balans te vinden tussen kosten en kwaliteit. Je bent resultaatgericht en weet wat het is om eigenaarschap te nemen. Jij maakt dingen graag makkelijk en concreet. Complexe vraagstukken zet jij gemakkelijk om naar begrijpelijke acties. Je houdt het hoofd koel als het even spannend wordt. Pieken, onverwachte uitval of last-minute wijzigingen brengen je niet van je stuk; je prioriteert, plant opnieuw en zorgt dat de operatie doordraait. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden. Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven. Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor. Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. title: Peer Review Operations Specialist - 2 Year FTC
description:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 2 Year FTC.

Role Summary

As a Peer Review Operations Specialist, you are a confident and highly organized self-starter, motivated by a culture of continuous improvement. You’re an excellent communicator and a natural team player, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and hold yourself accountable for meeting competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

Reporting to the Peer Review Operations Manager, you work as a member of the Peer Review Operations team to maintain efficient peer review workflows, ensure high vendor performance standards, and uphold excellent contributor experience for authors, editors, and reviewers. You will enforce turnaround time benchmarks for all peer review milestones to protect process integrity and ensure timeliness and quality of publication. You will have high standards of professional conduct in the workplace, and enjoy working with international colleagues from a range of cultures and settings. You will seek out opportunities for continuous quality improvement in department activities and be an effective champion of the PLOS vision, mission, and brand.

Responsibilities

Submission Management 

  • Ensure the timely, efficient peer review of all submissions
  • Ensure that queries or concerns escalated by vendors, Customer Care or other PLOS colleagues are addressed and resolved professionally and within required timelines, or escalated appropriately
  • Identify and remove barriers to submission, working collaboratively with colleagues across PLOS as required
  • Proactively identify workflow inefficiencies, variations or backlogs to diagnose persistent issues 
  • Ensure that manuscripts meet requirements and follow current policies and procedures

Workflows 

  • Troubleshoot persistent manuscript, workflow or system issues, providing expertise and advice, and exercising judgement to resolve the issue or escalate to the Peer Review Operations Manager or other colleagues as appropriate
  • Proactively raise data-driven recommendations for continuous journal operations and workflow improvements to the Peer Review Operations Manager
  • Ensure standard journal workflows are maintained as established, implementing and adopting process updates when approved by the Peer Review Operations Manager

Projects 

  • Contribute to workflow project and initiate proposals as requested, and undertake operations projects and initiatives as directed by the Peer Review Operations Manager
  • Serve as daily liaison with vendor representatives, monitoring quality and timeliness performance against target thresholds and KPIs

Other 

  • Contribute to other operational research outputs related to PLOS’s mission where required, so that our journal workflows are optimised to encourage scientific openness and transparency

Knowledge and Skills

Essential

  • Prior experience in peer-reviewed schololarly publishing
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral
  • Growth mindset with a collaborative, team player mentality
  • An ability to maintain a positive and professional customer service attitude
  • Able to work constructively with vendors, authors, editors, customers, and colleagues from a range of international settings
  • Knowledge of Excel, Word, file types and file conversions
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy
  • Able to set priorities and work independently
  • Upholds high standards of professionalism in the workplace
  • Embraces change with a positive attitude
  • An interest in science and in advancing scientific knowledge

Desirable

  • Knowledge of and expertise with peer review and manuscript management database systems; proficiency with Editorial Manager a plus
  • Knowledge of customer relationship management (CRM) software such as Salesforce
  • Awareness of and commitment to open science

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Some domestic and international travel required.

Qualifications

  • A university degree or equivalent experience 

 

The base salary range we've established for these positions is £27,000- £30,000. PLOS also offers a comprehenseive benefits package sumarized below.

BENEFITS: 

US:

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office 

 

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all.

description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Veeva Systems is seeking a Strategy Leader responsible for growing the Clinical Data business with the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
The small and medium-sized business (SMB) Strategy Leader of Clinical Data requires a familiarity with clinical research and/or healthcare data flow. The SMB Clinical Data Strategy Leader must demonstrate the ability to drive adoption discussions based on credibility and knowledge across multiple domains, including pharma/biotech, CRO, and technology partnership. The SMB Clinical Data Strategy Leader must demonstrate the ability to challenge customers to adopt new operating models and change their traditional way of thinking.
 
Vault Clinical Data comprises Electronic Data Capture (EDC) and Data Quality System (DQS). This role will be responsible for driving Clinical Data market strategy and growth across our emerging and mid-size  customers, working with the sales team, ensuring customer success, and developing a tailored market approach for customers with small internal teams. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of industry and technology leaders, who, together, are bringing the next generation of clinical development and R&D applications to Life Sciences.

description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind. 

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere. 

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs. 

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.  

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.


About the role
 
The Group Copy Supervisor plays an integral role in driving the creative development of high-quality copy and content for Avalere Health and one or more of our great clients. You will partner with other members of the creative team to develop copy and content, working closely with strategy, medical, client services, and other members of the team in these efforts. You will work together with the broader team to not only ensure our clients’ needs are met, but to strive to surpass their expectations.
 
Note: a portfolio featuring your pharma agency work must be submitted along with your resume.
 What we can offer You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August. Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business. We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Stage Ontwerp Infra/Civiel
description: Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stage lopen bij Dura Vermeer. Hoe ontwerp je een weg, brug of tunnel die veilig, duurzaam én uitvoerbaar is? Tijdens jouw ontwerpstage bij Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten ontdek je hoe jouw kennis in de praktijk samenkomt. Volg jij een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Civiele Techniek, Built Environment of vergelijkbaar? Je werkt mee aan grote infraprojecten, leert van ervaren ontwerpers en ontdekt welke ontwerprichting bij jou past. Dit wordt jouw stage Een goed infraproject begint bij een slim en integraal ontwerp. Binnen het cluster Ontwerp van Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten werken we met verschillende vakgroepen samen om complexe plannen te vertalen naar veilige, duurzame en uitvoerbare ontwerp oplossingen. Binnen het cluster werken collega’s vanuit ontwerpmanagement, civiel ontwerp – waaronder definitieve constructies, hulpconstructies en geotechniek – en Ontwerp GWW, met disciplines als wegontwerp, wegbouwkunde, ecologie en wateradvies. Daarnaast zijn ook omgevingsmanagement en technische installaties onderdeel van het cluster. Met dit cluster zorgen we ervoor dat een ontwerp niet alleen technisch klopt, maar ook maakbaar is en past binnen zijn omgeving. Als stagiair draai je mee binnen een vakgebied dat aansluit bij jouw opleiding en interesses. Je werkt mee aan echte projecten, krijgt begeleiding van ervaren collega’s en ontdekt hoe jouw bijdrage onderdeel wordt van een groter geheel. Zo bouw je bij Dura Vermeer niet alleen mee aan de infrastructuur van Nederland, maar ook aan je eigen toekomst. Hier zit je op je plek Je gaat aan de slag bij Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten en je bent betrokken bij de grootste en uitdagendste projecten van Dura Vermeer. Neem bijvoorbeeld de renovatie van de Drechttunnel, de aanleg van de infrastructuur van de containerterminal APM, de aanleg van de A15 nabij Arnhem of projecten die bijdragen aan de energietransitie zoals de bouw van de eerste 2GW Landstation in Nederland. Dit doe je samen met gedreven collega’s uit verschillende disciplines. Jij wordt onderdeel van de ontwerporganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Het cluster bestaat momenteel uit circa 160 collega’s, daarmee geven wij invulling aan onze ambitie als ontwerpende bouwer. Je werkt samen met mensen op de bouwplaats en deskundigen vanuit de leveranciers. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een hbo of wo opleiding in de richting van Civiele Techniek, Built Environment, Mobiliteit, Geotechniek of soort gelijk; Je bent op zoek naar een stage voor minimaal 4 dagen per week; Je bent proactief en durft vragen te stellen; Je bent flexibel, kan omgaan met veranderingen en werkt georganiseerd; Je hart gaat sneller kloppen van ontwerpen. Dit bieden wij jou Een mooie stagevergoeding van €700 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week; Bouw mee aan je toekomst: je stage is het perfecte startpunt om door te stromen naar een traineeship of startersbaan binnen Dura Vermeer; Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en je eigen initiatieven te laten horen; Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens; Goede begeleiding van een ervaren collega of manager in jouw vakgebied. Je werkt tijdens je stage samen met fijne collega's die zorgen voor een leuke en professionele werksfeer; Stage lopen én plezier maken: van kennismaking op de introductiedag tot leuke activiteiten en projectbezoeken met collega’s en mede stagiaires. Wil jij ook meer uit je stage halen? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Solliciteer direct via onze website met de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature (niet per e-mail). title: In Vivo Research Associate II, Konermann Lab
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

We are seeking an In Vivo Research Associate II to join the Konermann Laboratory at the Arc Institute.You will collaborate closely with experienced scientists to advance in vivo projects focused on understanding brain development.

This project builds on previous work in genome-scale CRISPR screening (Konermann et al., 2015; Biering et al., 2021; Wei et al., 2023; Roohani et al., 2025) and aims to combine modern functional genomics and neuroscience tools to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying brain development and function. The ideal candidate will have experience in animal handling and colony management, intracerebral injections, sample processing for single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial pipelines, and imaging. This position offers an excellent opportunity for candidates considering PhD programs, as it involves participation in all stages of a research project under the guidance of an experienced scientist.

About You

  • You love science and learning. Whether it's a new field or a new bench technique, you stay curious and enjoy stepping outside your comfort zone.
  • You are detail-oriented. You're careful and diligent about documentation and good lab practice, and you like keeping things organized.
  • You collaborate and help others. Science is a team effort, and you take the initiative to pitch in.
  • You are a problem solver. Experiments rarely work the first time. You bring patience and confidence to complex technical troubleshooting.

 In this position, you will

  • Plan, execute, analyze, and troubleshoot experiments with a high degree of independence, with continued support from the rest of the team
  • Perform in vivo mouse experiments, including stereotaxic surgeries, as well as IV and IP injections
  • Collect and process tissue, including vibratome and/or cryostat sectioning, immunostaining, and imaging
  • Comply with federal, Arc, and local IACUC/AAALAC regulations governing animal research
  • Follow Arc's standards for code of conduct, safety, and the handling of hazardous materials, biological materials, and controlled substances
  • Analyze and present data at subgroup meetings and seminars
  • Maintain an organized, detailed lab notebook

Job Requirements

  • BS with 2+ years of relevant experience, or MS, in molecular biology, neuroscience, or another relevant field. Relevant experience includes independent lab work during undergraduate studies
  • Strong experience working with laboratory animals, including handling, restraint, and procedures under an approved protocol (intracranial, IV, and IP injections, as well as perfusions)
  • Detail-oriented, with excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Outstanding critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Highly motivated and curious, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team
  • Ability to work some weekends as needed (days off can be swapped for weekdays

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience with cloning via Gibson assembly or Golden Gate protocols (library cloning experience is a plus)
  • Knowledge of and experience with NGS library preparation, particularly single-cell and spatial workflows
  • Computational skills (Python or R)

The base salary for this position is $75,900. This amount does not include benefits or other forms of compensation.

description:
Profluent is the frontier AI lab for biology. Profluent builds powerful foundation models for all of life's molecules, unlocking solutions that transform medicine, agriculture, and beyond. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Emeryville, CA, Profluent is backed by leading investors including Altimeter Capital, Bezos Expeditions, Spark Capital, Insight Partners, Air Street Capital, AIX Ventures, and Convergent Ventures and has raised over $150M to date.

The Role

Profluent is seeking a motivated, rigorous, and collaborative scientist to establish and lead a centralized gene editor screening function. High-quality experimental data is a core input to our protein design models, and this role will own the screening operations that produce it.

This role centers on building and running a screening core responsible for assay standardization, data quality, and team development. At first, you will support campaigns that generate training and evaluation data for our protein design models, and the scope may grow to cover more programs. You will design, run, and troubleshoot mammalian genome editing assays with NGS readouts in arrayed and pooled formats. You will set the technical standards that make our data reproducible and trustworthy. You will also build and mentor a team of Research Associates, and coordinate closely with Automation, Bioinformatics, Data Science, and Biology to keep the screening pipeline running smoothly from start to finish.

As a leader of the team, you will balance hands-on scientific execution with people management and process development. You will identify, prioritize, and drive infrastructure projects that improve throughput, consistency, and assay sensitivity. You will also work with leadership to shape the long-term scope of the core.

We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who share our commitment to revolutionizing biology, driving meaningful innovation, and making a lasting impact on global healthcare.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI-driven protein design while collaborating with a dynamic, interdisciplinary team of experts in machine learning, protein engineering, cell biology, and gene editing.

 

Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a team of 2–4 Research Associates, including hiring, training, performance management, and career development
  • Train and mentor staff on aseptic technique, assay execution, and documentation standards
  • Foster a supportive team culture that prioritizes growth, engagement, and well-being

Execution

  • Prioritize, schedule, and resource cross-functional experiments in coordination with Automation and Bioinformatics
  • Design, execute, troubleshoot, and analyze mammalian genome editing assays with NGS readouts in arrayed and pooled formats
  • Onboard new assays and extend existing assays to new enzyme classes
  • Maintain sample chain of custody from plate mapping through automation, sample preparation, and sequencing submission, partnering with Bioinformatics on data schema and capture
  • Communicate technical results clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences
  • Deliver QC'd, analysis-ready datasets with documented QC flags to ML

Process Development

  • Define and enforce technical standards, and write and maintain SOPs
  • Qualify new assays and define acceptance criteria based on reproducibility data
  • Maintain cell line quality and inventory for screening assays, in coordination with teams that manage cell banks
  • Characterize assay sensitivity, including the minimum detectable difference in activity at standard replicate counts
  • Identify, prioritize, and plan infrastructure projects that continually improve assays and processes
  • Coordinate process development across Automation, Bioinformatics, Data Science, and Biology
  • Evaluate the costs and benefits of centralizing high-throughput workflows in partnership with other teams
  • Work with leadership to assess and refine the scope of core functions

 

Qualifications

  • PhD in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, or a related field and 2+ years of relevant industry experience, or MS in a related field and 10+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Hands-on experience with bacterial and mammalian cell culture, genome editing, and NGS-based assays
  • Experience with high-throughput experimentation and analysis of large datasets
  • Experience with LIMS or ELN systems for sample and experiment tracking
  • Demonstrated ability to establish technical standards and drive consistent execution across operators

  • Track record of building or improving high-throughput processes
  • Experience leading infrastructure or process improvement projects

Generate’s Prototyping Lab builds the experimental systems that let us measure protein function at unprecedented scale. By combining synthetic biology, large DNA libraries, high-throughput assays, and machine learning, the team creates workflows that turn complex biological questions into rich, usable datasets. 

We’re looking for two Scientists with a strong record in experimental synthetic biology to develop pooled screens capable of testing hundreds of thousands of protein variants in parallel to identify protein binders and modulators. You’ll shape these experiments via DNA library design, pooled in vitro protein display, and NGS-based enrichment analysis. For one of the two roles, we are looking for a Scientist who additionally has experience in mammalian cell engineering and membrane protein studies. Experience in computational modeling or statistical analysis would help you connect experimental design to the quality and usefulness of the resulting data. 

You’ll work closely with Protein Sciences and Machine Learning teams to build screening approaches that deliver clear, quantitative insight into protein function. The role offers substantial scope to originate and advance new technologies, with close collaboration across a well-resourced biotech team.
