title: Candidate Experience Coordinator, Cambridge, MA
description:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.

The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 

Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.

The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you. 

 

About Iso

Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.

Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.

Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

 

Your impact 

As a Candidate Experience Coordinator, you are the engine of our Talent Acquisition (TA) function. You won’t just support recruitment; you will architect, own, and lead the candidate journey through interdisciplinary collaboration.

Overseeing complex global scheduling, you will own the holistic end-to-end candidate experience— running an efficient and exceptional interview process from the first touchpoint to the final stages. You will drive data integrity to influence hiring decisions, whilst also serving as a process engineer who identifies bottlenecks and implements smoother workflows. This position is designed as a launchpad for your career, giving you interdisciplinary visibility and significant project ownership across the talent acquisition lifecycle.

What you will do 

1. Own the Candidate Experience Architecture

  • Curate the Journey: Act as a primary, consistent point of contact for candidates, ensuring every interaction is timely, seamless, and supportive. You will seamlessly balance high volume scheduling with candidate care.
  • Host the Onsite Experience: Act as the host and central lead for our onsite (or virtual) interview days, ensuring candidates feel welcomed, prepared, and impressed.
  • Humanise Communication: Partner across the team to design candidate communications. You will ensure our templates are authentic and aligned with our values, including managing early-stage rejections with empathy and professionalism.
  • Scheduling Excellence: Orchestrate complex, interdisciplinary interview loops across multiple time zones with speed and efficiency, proactively managing any last-minute changes with candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers.

2. Drive Operational Excellence & Data Integrity

  • Be a "Data Guardian”: Champion the quality and consistency of our data within our ATS (Greenhouse). You will manage job set up, build interview processes and ensure  candidate statuses are meticulously maintained to enable accurate reporting.

Onboarding Operations: Oversee critical onboarding and compliance operations, such as right-to-work checks, pobu (integrating people data with relevant google systems), and background checks. Upskill and educate the talent team on criticality of accurate data and Greenhouse (ATS) best practices in both hiring and onboarding processes.

  • Feedback Loops: Partner with the Principal Talent Lead to analyse candidate survey data. You will turn these insights into meaningful actions, blending data-driven and experiential perspectives to continuously elevate our standards.
  • Identify & Eradicate Bottlenecks: Proactively flag recurring scheduling challenges or process delays. You won’t just follow the process; you will help evolve it by suggesting improvements and piloting new workflows.

3. Enablement & Strategic Partnership

  • Scaling processes: Utilising AI, you will assist in documenting core processes for TA, creating clear and consistent guides for everything from complex scheduling to offer approval workflows. Additionally, you will ensure effective training for any new coordinators and wider TA members.
  • Champion Interdisciplinary Partnership: You will have opportunities for domain alignment with specific verticals, allowing you to build deeper context on the roles you support and partner closely with Hiring Managers, thereby leveraging diverse skills and perspectives across the business.

Skills and qualifications 

Essential:

  • Exceptional Organisation: Ability to prioritise multiple functions and tasks while maintaining the highest attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience Centric: A strong focus on providing the best possible candidate experience, with the empathy to manage relationships through the entire recruitment lifecycle.
  • Tech & Data Savvy: Experience using online calendar/meeting applications (G-Suite preferred) and a data-driven approach with a strong desire to advocate for clean data.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills, capable of keeping stakeholders updated and writing "human-first" correspondence.
  • Global Mindset: Experience scheduling and complex coordination across multiple time zones.
  • Process Mindset: The ability to learn complex systems quickly and a willingness to question "how things are done" to find better solutions.

Nice to have:

  • ATS Expertise: Deep experience with Applicant Tracking Systems, specifically Greenhouse
  • Project Management: Experience leading or contributing to operational projects (e.g., event logistics, data cleanup, survey rollouts).
  • Agency or Search Firm Experience: Experience acting as the main point of contact for external partners.


Culture and values

We are guided by our shared values. It's not about finding people who think and act in the same way. These values help to guide our work and will continue to strengthen it. 

Thoughtful
Thoughtful at Iso is about curiosity, creativity and care. It is about good people doing good, rigorous and future-making science every single day.

Brave
Brave at Iso is about fearlessness, but it’s also about initiative and integrity. The scale of the challenge demands nothing less.

Determined
Determined at Iso is the way we pursue our goal. It’s a confidence in our hypothesis, as well as the urgency and agility needed to deliver on it. Because disease won’t wait, so neither should we.

Together
Together at Iso is about connection, collaboration across fields and catalytic relationships. It’s knowing that transformation is a group project, and remembering that what we’re doing will have a real impact on real people everywhere.


Creating an extraordinary company

We believe that to be successful we need a team with a range of skills and talents. We're building an environment where collaboration is fundamental, learning is shared and every employee feels supported and able to thrive. We value unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, and perspectives, and harness these qualities to create extraordinary impact.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis protected by applicable law. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.


Hybrid working

It’s hugely important for us to share knowledge and build strong relationships with each other, and we find it easier to do this if we spend time together in person. This is why we follow a hybrid model, and would require you to be able to come into the office 3 days a week (currently Tuesday, Wednesday, and one other day depending on which team you’re in). If you have additional needs that would prevent you from following this hybrid approach, we’d be happy to talk through these if you’re selected for an initial screening call.

Please note that when you submit an application, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

ポジション概要

Customer Experience Directorは、コマーシャルエクセレンス組織における戦略的リーダーとして、日本市場における顧客エンゲージメント戦略全般の設計および最適化を担います。

具体的には、Sales Force Effectiveness（SFE）およびCustomer Relationship Management（CRM）、デジタルケイパビリティの構築を統括し、オムニチャネルにおけるさまざまな顧客接点を通じて、一貫性のある顧客中心のエンゲージメントの実現をリードしていただきます。

また、本ポジションはコマーシャルエクセレンス責任者の下で、コマーシャル、メディカルアフェアーズ、マーケティング、トレーニング、データ・アナリティクスおよびグローバルなどの関係部門と密接に連携しながら、顧客体験の向上、営業組織の効率化ならびに事業成長を展開していただきます。オンコロジー製品の上市準備および中長期的な事業成長を支える重要な役割を担います。

主な職務内容:

  • 日本市場における、事業目標・上市戦略および顧客ニーズに則した顧客体験戦略の策定・推進。

  • チャネル戦略、個別化、MR活動とデジタル施策の連携および顧客体験の評価を含む、オムニチャネルエンゲージメントモデルを設計・最適化する。各チームによる革新的な手法の開発・評価をリードし、チャネル、業務プロセスおよび技術にまたがる複雑な課題を解決する。

  • MR組織の人員配置・規模設計、セグメンテーションおよびターゲティング、テリトリーデザイン、コールプランニング、営業活動の効果測定など、営業組織の最適化戦略のリード及びSFE施策の設計（実行面ではセールスオペレーションチームと連携する）。

  • 市場ポテンシャル、ターゲットおよび営業活動計画に基づき、営業予算の配分基準を策定し、Sales Operationsおよび営業リーダーに最適な配分を提言する。承認された計画と委譲された権限の範囲内で、SFE、CRMおよびデジタルの予算とリソース配分の調整を担い、投資の有効性と事業への影響を管理する。

  • セールスインセンティブや表彰制度などの設計、提案、コミュニケーション、効果検証。

  • 顧客セグメンテーション、ステークホルダー分析、アカウントプラン策定および部門横断的な顧客対応体制の構築など、重点施設・重点顧客に対する戦略的アカウントマネジメントの高度化推進・フレームワーク構築。

  • CRM、デジタルおよび顧客エンゲージメントプラットフォームのコマーシャル部門のビジネスオーナーとして、ITおよびSales Operationsと連携し、業務要件を定義して優先順位を決定する。委譲された権限と合意されたガバナンスの範囲内で、業務上の実装に関する最終判断を行い、活用定着、業務の有効性およびビジネス価値に責任を持つ。

  • 顧客インサイト、MRからの情報、CRM分析および営業実績データを統合し、顧客中心の意思決定を推進する。複数領域のKPIと評価基準を設定し、高度な分析によって重要な事業課題を解決するとともに、顧客エンゲージメントと投資優先順位に関する上級管理職の意思決定に影響力を発揮する。

  • 関連部門と連携し、顧客体験、SFE、CRMおよびデジタルの上市準備をリードし、顧客データ管理、同意取得およびコミュニケーション希望に関する方針とガバナンスの整備に貢献する。これらの領域を横断する戦略的変革を主導し、スポンサーの確保、コミュニケーション計画の策定、リソースと研修の整備および継続的な定着を推進する。

必須スキル・経験・学歴:

  • ビジネス、ライフサイエンス、マーケティング、データ分析または関連分野における学士号。

  • 製薬・バイオテクノロジー業界における、コマーシャルエクセレンス、顧客体験、CRM、SFE、オムニチャネルエンゲージメントまたはコンサルティングに関連する10年以上の実務経験。複数のコマーシャルエクセレンス領域にまたがるチームを率いた経験を含む。

  • 顧客エンゲージメント、SFE、CRMまたはコマーシャルエクセレンスの戦略を連携した計画へ落とし込み、実行、業務の有効性および測定可能な事業成果に責任を持った実績。

  • 領域を横断する変革をリードし、上級管理職と優先順位やリソース配分の調整について交渉し、担当範囲の方針および重要な事業上の意思決定に影響力を発揮した実績。

  • 組織マネジメント、予算・ベンダー管理および人材育成の経験。チームに権限を委譲し、包摂的で企業価値に基づく文化を築く能力。

  • 日本語ネイティブレベルおよびビジネスレベルの英語コミュニケーション能力。

歓迎するスキル:

title: Assistant Video Editor
description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

Vox Media is looking for an Assistant Video Editor to join a growing post-production team within the branded content division for Vox and New York Magazine. This role is built for an editor early in their career who is sharp with turnkey and templated formats, comfortable owning quick-turn social cuts independently, and eager to grow into larger, more complex projects under supervision. You'll also work closely with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external editors, making you a key connective piece between in-house editing and the freelance bench.

 

Editing and Craft

  • Edit turnkey and templated content such as cutdowns, recaps, and repeatable social formats for various platforms
  • Cut quick-turn social edits independently, following established templates and house style
  • Take on larger or more complex edits with guidance from the Post-Production Supervisor and Creative Directors, building toward independent ownership of bigger projects over time
  • Add basic music and sound design to elevate templated pieces
  • Apply light color and LUTs following house presets

Project Setup and Coordination

  • Partner with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external/freelance editors such as bins, sequences, and file structure, following in-house SOPs
  • Create stringouts for Editors and Creative Directors per project
  • Prep and organize incoming footage, dailies, and assets ahead of handoff to external editors
  • Support project wrap-out and archiving, keeping files clean and organized across both in-house and external-editor projects

 

Workflow and Technical

  • Work in Adobe Premiere, including Team Projects and Productions, following house SOPs for project, bin, sequence, and track structure
  • Support turnovers to color and sound mix during finishing on larger projects
  • Work flexibly across a remote and hybrid workflow, including shipping/receiving drives and cloud sync as needed

 

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Share cuts via Frame.io and address internal notes accurately, flagging concerns proactively
  • Maintain clear communication with producers, the Post-Production Supervisor, and external editors
  • Learn from and support senior editors on shared projects, with room to grow into more senior editing responsibility over time

WHO YOU ARE

  • 2-3 years of experience editing in a digital, social, or branded content environment
  • Comfortable and fast with templated, repeatable edit formats, with a desire to grow into more complex, independent work
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere; familiarity with team projects/Productions is a plus
  • Comprehensive knowledge of technical specifications for distribution across all digital platforms
  • Organized and detail-oriented - comfortable managing file structure and project setup, not just cutting
  • Familiarity with Frame.io or similar review/delivery tools

 

WHERE YOU'LL WORK

This role is based in our New York City office. You’ll work a hybrid schedule: in-office three days a week & remote two days a week.

PAY TRANSPARENCY

The salary range listed below represents the minimum and maximum base pay for this position at the time of this posting. Final salary offered to the candidate selected for the position will be based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience.

Pay Range

title: Bioinformatics Scientist
description:
Natera is seeking a Bioinformatics Scientist to join our Bioinformatics Research & Development team with a focus on cancer recurrence monitoring. Natera’s mission is to change the management of disease worldwide with a focus on reproductive health, cancer, and organ transplantation.

The ideal candidate should have experience in sequencing data analysis, genomics, and/or algorithm development. This individual will analyze large and complex high-throughput cancer genomics datasets. They will also assist in developing novel computational methods, and integrating frameworks developed by our R&D team.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Analyze high-throughput DNA sequencing datasets utilizing understanding of cancer biology and genomics. Help implement and validate novel algorithms and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with molecular biologists and other bioinformatics scientists to answer biological questions
  • Contribute to experimental design and quality control
  • Help develop tools and end-to-end bioinformatics pipelines

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, engineering, molecular biology, or a related field; Master's degree preferred
  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience doing high-throughput genomic sequencing analysis

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Experience doing NGS data analysis (e.g. mapping, variant calling, etc.)
  • Strong programming skills in a scientific programming language, Python strongly preferred
  • Knowledge of genomics, with a preference for familiarity with cancer biology
  • Familiarity with public databases such as TCGA, COSMIC, or OncoKB
  • Experience with Linux command-line tools and shell scripting
  • Ability to conduct hypothesis-driven research, visualize data, and effectively communicate results
  • Ability to collaborate effectively, self-motivated, and detail-oriented

PREFERRED SKILLS:

  • Background in ML and statistics
  • Experience with WGS

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. title: Business Development Representative (founding team)
description: Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions. We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates. We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies. We are signing our first corporate design partnerships this September. Tasks Founding Business Development Representative We are looking for a Founding BDR to open Raison's pipeline. You will find the companies where AI has been deployed but isn't actually used, reach the person who has to answer for it, and turn that conversation into a qualified meeting with our Account Executive and founders. You will reach out to Transformation leads, Heads of AI, CFOs and COOs in mid-sized companies at the moment something forces them to act: their board, CEO or PE fund is asking what AI has delivered, or the person who carried the AI program is leaving. Our wedge isn't one more training session. It's making AI stick across every team, and showing what actually changed. You'll need to tell that story in two sentences, on the phone and in writing. As a founding commercial hire, you'll work hand-in-hand with the CEO, our AE and the founding GTM/Ops. What you hear in the field will shape who we target and how we talk to them. This role is perfect for someone early in their sales career who'd rather learn by building than by running someone else's script: no inbound engine, no big brand yet; only a sharp story, real signals and you. What you will do: Spot the signals that matter before anyone else: a new Head of AI, a departing AI champion, an AI committee being set up, a board or fund pushing on AI, then reach the right person. Run personalized outbound on LinkedIn, email and phone. Our best results come from one well-researched message, not a hundred automated ones. Qualify every conversation against what actually predicts a deal: has the company already started acting on this before talking to us? Who is asking for results, and by when? Book qualified meetings for our AE and founders, with a clean handoff: the trigger, the team, the buyer. Feed what you hear straight back to the team (objections, vocabulary, which titles answer and which don't) Requirements Who you are: 1–3 years in a sales, BDR/SDR or growth role, ideally in B2B SaaS or consulting. You write short, sharp messages that people answer, and you're comfortable on the phone with a C/VP-level. You use AI every day, including to research your prospects. You're resilient: most messages won't get a reply, and you treat every "no" as data. Organized and rigorous: you log everything, because we learn from patterns, not anecdotes. Fluent in French and English. You want to grow into an AE role as the company scales. Benefits A founding role with equity and direct influence on company strategy. Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Paris startup ecosystem. Flexibility: remote-friendly with regular in-person collaboration in Paris and an office in Montmartre with a beautiful Sacré-Coeur view. A front-row seat to one of the most important shifts in how humans learn. A small, sharp team that ships fast and trusts each other to figure things out. If you want ownership, equity, and the kind of career-defining challenge that only comes from being early, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and join Raison at the forefront of the AI-for-learning revolution. Raison is an equal opportunity employer. title: Account Manager - Medical
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Manager to join our growing team!

As an Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium-sized projects. As a captain, you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead.

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans

  • Take responsibility for the day-to-day management of your account, including managing the processes of the account (including running regular internal team meetings), flow of work (review content developed by more junior team members), delegation of tasks (oversee status reports to ensure all team actions are complete) and the status of jobs across the account (not just your own)

  • Ownership of and accountability for medium-sized client projects, ensuring that projects are delivered to highest possible standards within budget and agreed timeframes

  • Actively demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work

  • Confidently develop written content (briefing documents, etc) and gain experience reviewing junior team members’ work, ensuring content is accurate and developed to a high standard ahead of more senior review

 

Business development

  • Start to identify areas for growth (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics), proactively sharing new ideas with your team and client

  • Take an active role in new business, which may include undertaking and presenting research to the pitch team, or facilitating team input via brainstorms/presenting as part of the pitch team

 

Team management

  • Maintain an awareness of the professional development of more junior team members on your accounts, through regular catch ups and interactions

  • Develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members

  • Buddy new SAA/AM starters

 

Financial management

  • Develop a greater understanding of the account finances beyond your projects, proactively supporting your account lead with financial management including managing Salesforce opportunities, invoicing and forecasting

  • Develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting on previous projects and gathering cost quotes

  • Manage the budget for projects that you own, feeding into your account lead as part of the broader programme finances; identify where project is going out of scope and alert your account lead with details of additional budget required

  • Input into the resourcing process by sharing with your account/medical writer lead the requirements for your projects

  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)

  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

What you should have: 

  • Relevant degree in a scientific subject

  • Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail

  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration

  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines

  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable

  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget

  • Ability to develop project scopes and vendor contracts

  • Excellent business communication ability, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills

  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. Some positions offer hybrid or remote flexibility, while others require regular in-office presence. For example, certain teams and regions, including some of our UK operations, have office-based requirements. Your recruiter will discuss the specific expectations for the role you're pursuing during the interview process and keep you informed throughout the hiring journey. For employees located within a one-hour commute of a Real Chemistry office, we require in-person attendance two days per week, either from a Real Chemistry office or when working onsite with clients. Employees in regions without a nearby office may work remotely and come together throughout the year for collaboration, culture-building, learning, and team connection opportunities. While these guidelines reflect our current workplace model, we understand that everyone’s circumstances are unique. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

Real Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity employer. We continually strive to build and sustain an inclusive and equitable work environment where our employees feel empowered to leverage all they bring from their personal lived experience and professional expertise, to make our team the best in the industry. We encourage motivated and qualified applicants to apply without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, ethnic or national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Real Chemistry operates. Should you require accommodations throughout the interview process please let your recruiter know.

Do not share personal or financial information or make payments to any unverified sources claiming to be connected to Real Chemistry. title: Hydrographer/Geophysicist
description: The Role We are the explorers. We are the builders. We are the Wayfinders. Bedrock is mapping the unseen world beneath our oceans and building the systems to do it at scale. We're hiring a Hydrographer/Geophysicist to work with some of the highest-resolution seafloor data on the planet. You'll process and analyze multibeam, sidescan, magnetometer, and sub-bottom data from Bedrock field tests and commercial operations, and you'll own rapid, iterative feedback on data quality. When something looks strange in a dataset, you'll be the person asking what it tells us about the vehicle, the survey plan, or the seafloor itself. You will also be in front of customers discussing data quality, interpretation, and deliverables, and teaching them how to read what they're seeing and what it's worth. This is a role for someone who relishes that part of the job. And you'll be on the leading edge of the field. Bedrock is working with major governments around the world on how uncertainty and accuracy should be defined in ocean data- literally helping write the book, the policy, and the guidelines. This is the team revolutionizing how the seafloor gets characterized, and you'd have a say in what the next decade of this field looks like. We are hiring for curiosity, speed of learning, and real excitement about seeing the seafloor in higher fidelity than anyone has seen it before. If you have most of what's below and you're hungry to learn the rest, we want to talk to you. What You'll Do Data Processing & Quality First-pass analysis of MBES, SSS, magnetometer, and/or sub-bottom profiler data using commercial software (Qimera, Seaview, SonarWiz, Radex, etc.) Own rapid, iterative feedback on data quality- first pass gets us information, not perfection Spot artifacts and anomalies, and reason about what caused them Work with Bedrock leadership and customers to hold the highest data quality standard in the industry Clients & Education Create data products and write-ups for commercial clients Serve as a primary point of contact for data quality issues, interpretations, and deliverables Teach clients about the unique value of AUV data, and what they can do with it- bring them on the journey rather than handing over a file Explain trade-offs, limitations, and uncertainty clearly, directly, and without defensiveness The Leading Edge Contribute to how uncertainty and accuracy get defined in ocean data-work that feeds into government standards, policy, and guidelines Collaborate with product and engineering on iterative improvements to the vehicle and to survey planning Help build the processing workflows that let all of this scale Who You Are You're a curious, fast-learning data person who wants to be on the vanguard of ocean data, and who would rather be in the conversation with the customer than behind it. Experience Experience processing and reporting on at least two of: MBES, SSS, magnetometer, sub-bottom profiler, using commercial software Comfort with ArcGIS, QGIS, and/or AutoCAD Experience writing data reports for commercial clients Attention to detail- you find the artifact nobody else saw Nice to Have Experience across all four relevant sensor types (MBES, SSS, magnetometer, sub-bottom profiler) Light coding (Python/SQL) Offshore experience (ship or AUV ops) Certified Hydrographer, Cat A or Cat B; Licensed Surveyor Experience across defense (mine countermeasures, unexploded ordnance), energy (oil & gas, offshore wind), and/or environmental survey How You Operate You learn fast, and you ask good questions when you are uncertain You treat processing as a problem-solving activity, not a checkbox exercise Iterative by instinct, you improve the data and the workflow with every pass Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities change You use tools and AI to increase speed, accuracy, and leverage You are comfortable, clear, and collaborative in front of a customer What You Care About The idea of seeing the seafloor in a way no one has seen it before excites you You take pride in craft, clarity, and accuracy You have some connection to the ocean, professional, academic, or personal and you are excited to be around people who dive, sail, build, and explore offshore Not a Fit If... You want the data perfect on the first pass-iterative improvement is our way You are uncomfortable with uncertainty or with rapid changes in priorities You are not interested in learning new tools and approaches You do not want to interface directly with clients, or you see customer education as a distraction from the real work You are looking for predictable hours and firm boundaries around when the work happens. This job will require some nights and weekends around survey campaigns. Estimated compensation for this position is $95,000- $130,000 annually plus equity. Actual salary offered will be based on qualifications, experience, and location (SF and NY being at the high end of the band). If you want to work on the highest-resolution seafloor data on the planet and help decide what comes next in this field, we should talk.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Your Impact

This is a hands-on opportunity to apply what you're learning about signal processing to a real product that keeps people and critical infrastructure safe. As a Working Student on our RF Engineering team in Kassel, you'll work alongside experienced DSP engineers — prototyping algorithms, analyzing real RF captures, and building the tooling that helps us detect and classify drones in the wild. You'll grow your practical DSP and software skills on real-world data, with mentorship and room to take ownership of meaningful pieces of work.

What You'll Do

Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

  • Help prototype, implement, and test DSP algorithms in Python and C++.
  • Analyze recorded RF / I/Q captures and help characterize drone and controller signals.
  • Build and improve scripts and tooling for signal analysis, data handling, and visualization.
  • Run experiments and document results to support detection and classification work.

What You Bring

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Coursework or project experience in DSP fundamentals (e.g., sampling, filtering, FFT/spectral analysis, modulation).
  • Programming experience in Python and/or C++.
  • Genuine curiosity about RF / wireless and signal processing, and an eagerness to learn on real data.
  • Good communication skills in English; German is a plus.

title: Junior Commercial Associate — Works in Progress
description:
Location: London, in office
Reports to: Head of Commercial and Audiovisual, Works in Progress
Salary: £30k-35k 

About Works in Progress

Works in Progress is Stripe’s magazine of new and underrated ideas to improve the world. We publish an eclectic mix of articles on policy, economics, business, technology, science, history, arts and culture.

Our audience is growing quickly and includes people making things happen, particularly in technology and politics. We are expanding the commercial side of the magazine—including advertising, subscriptions, events and partnerships—and are looking for an ambitious graduate to help us build it.

The role

This is an entry-level commercial role for a recent graduate who is ambitious, organised and excited to learn quickly in a small, entrepreneurial team.

You will work closely with the Director of Commercial and Audiovisual across the magazine’s commercial activity: advertising, subscriptions, events, marketing and partnerships. You will help keep commercial projects moving by conducting research, supporting outreach, maintaining pipelines and trackers, following up with prospective partners, and contributing to growth experiments.

You will learn by doing: writing outbound emails, building target lists, preparing materials, tracking results, joining calls and following up consistently. It is a strong opportunity for someone who wants early exposure to senior commercial work and meaningful responsibility from the start of their career.

What you’ll do

  • Support the advertising sales process, including preparing rate cards, pitch decks, outreach and pipeline materials.
  • Research and build target lists of potential advertisers, sponsors, agencies, founders, investors and partners.
  • Draft clear, thoughtful outbound emails and follow-ups.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, commercial trackers and reporting.
  • Support subscription growth through acquisition and retention ideas, and help measure their effectiveness.
  • Help develop the events business, including sponsor research, partnership outreach and event planning support.
  • Assist with early marketing and growth experiments across paid acquisition, referrals, partnerships, direct mail and audience development.
  • Prepare decks, reports and briefing materials that help commercial conversations move forward.
  • Join meetings and calls with clients, partners and agencies, taking notes and supporting follow-up.
  • Help turn commercial ideas into clear proposals with pricing, positioning and next steps.
  • Work across sales, marketing, events and subscriptions, adapting quickly as priorities evolve.
  • Take on the practical, sometimes unglamorous work needed to help a small business grow.

We’re looking for someone who

  • Is a recent graduate, or has equivalent early-career experience.
  • Is excited by commercial work and motivated by helping ideas turn into revenue.
  • Is interested in sales, marketing, partnerships, media, events or business development.
  • Is highly organised and comfortable managing lists, trackers and multiple follow-ups.
  • Is numerate and confident using spreadsheets.
  • Is a sharp, clear writer who can communicate professionally over email and in presentations.
  • Is proactive, resilient and comfortable reaching out to people they do not know.
  • Is curious, resourceful and willing to learn quickly.
  • Enjoys working in a small team where everyone pitches in.
  • Is comfortable with both high-profile opportunities and repetitive operational work, such as researching prospects and following up on outreach.
  • Has an interest in media, publishing, technology, economics, policy or culture. Previous media or publishing experience is helpful but not required.

Working at Works in Progress

This role is based in London and requires working from the office every day. You will be part of a small, ambitious team that cares deeply about the magazine and its growth. In return, you will get a steep learning curve, close mentorship and the chance to contribute directly to building the commercial future of Works in Progress.

HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

description: About Ryft Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms. We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity. We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform. About the Job Are you an engineering leader who wants to own the systems that connect physical point-of-sale hardware to a modern, scalable payments platform? We are looking for a Tech Lead to head up our Card Present (In-Person Payments) squad. You will lead the technical direction and hands-on delivery of the infrastructure that allows our merchants to take physical payments. You'll work across our C#/.NET backend on AWS, shaping how physical card taps and inserts securely communicate with our event-driven services, split funds, and settle correctly. This is a hands-on, high-impact leadership role. You won't just be managing a Jira board, you'll be deep in the architecture, writing code, mentoring your squad, and owning the technical strategy for our physical terminal estate. You will bridge the gap between cloud infrastructure and physical hardware, ensuring our in-person payment flows are as robust, scalable, and developer-friendly as our online ones. What You'll Work On In-person payments architecture: Leading the technical design for our card-present estate, ensuring low-latency, highly reliable communication between physical terminals and our AWS backend. Terminal & Gateway Integration: Building the critical paths that connect smart payment terminals and Point of Sale (POS) systems into Ryft’s core gateway and marketplace routing logic. Hardware-to-cloud flows: Handling the unique complexities of physical payments: offline modes, state synchronization, hardware webhooks, and complex failure modes. Security & Compliance pipelines: Ensuring our physical payment flows remain airtight and fully compliant within heavily regulated environments. Squad Leadership: Setting the technical standard for the Card Present squad. Breaking down complex product requirements into actionable architecture and guiding engineers through delivery. The platform itself: Contributing to our broader event-driven C#/.NET service estate, infrastructure-as-code, and observability tooling alongside other Tech Leads. Responsibilities Lead technical delivery: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end features for our card-present offering. You are the ultimate technical owner of what your squad ships. Design for hardware-cloud correctness: Write and architect services that behave under network drops, partial failure, and hardware concurrency. Idempotency and absolute accuracy are the job, not edge cases. Raise the bar & mentor: Improve the codebase and our engineering practices. Review code rigorously, set conventions, and level up the engineers in your squad. Own it in production: Take real ownership of what goes live: instrumentation, alerting, and incident response for a system where physical merchants are relying on your uptime to make a living. Harness AI, stay in control: Use AI-assisted workflows to multiply your output (we invest heavily in them) while remaining in full command of every line you ship and review. Collaborate: Work day-to-day with your Engineering Manager, Product Managers, hardware vendors, and other squads to deliver seamless omnichannel payment features. Experience & Skills Required Technical Leadership: Proven experience leading technical projects, architecting complex backend systems, and guiding small teams of engineers to deliver high-quality software. Strong backend engineering: Significant commercial experience building and running production backend services. Our backend is C#/.NET, so depth there is ideal, but if you're excellent in another modern typed language and will get fluent fast, we want to hear from you. AWS in production: Hands-on experience running distributed services on AWS (ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SNS/SQS, DynamoDB or similar) and understanding the operational reality that comes with them. Distributed systems judgement: Comfortable reasoning about service boundaries, asynchronous messaging, eventual consistency, and building resilient systems that handle downstream provider outages. AI-augmented, engineer-first: You use AI coding tools effectively to move faster, but you review, understand, and take full ownership of the output. We are not looking for someone who ships code they can't explain. Fast, self-directed learner: A track record of getting productive quickly in unfamiliar domains. Enthusiasm to master the complexities of hardware-software interactions matters more to us than knowing it all on day one. Nice to Have POS & Terminal Integration: Existing experience integrating physical payment terminals, card readers, or Point of Sale (POS) systems into payment gateways. Android Experience: Familiarity with Android development, specifically in the context of building or maintaining applications for smart payment terminals. PCI-DSS & Compliance: Deep understanding of payment scheme rules, PCI-DSS compliance, EMV standards, or Point-to-Point Encryption (P2PE). Infrastructure ownership: Infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and containerisation. Why Ryft? If you want to build the systems that move money in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you. Role Description As a Real Estate Analyst at Checkout.com, you will provide dedicated administrative, data management, and operational support to the Head of Real Estate, focusing on mitigating risk and increasing efficiency across the global portfolio. This role is essential for managing high-risk operational tasks, such as lease event tracking, lease administration, budgeting and data reporting to ensure a structured approach and prevent critical errors. Manage operational risk by ensuring all key details related to lease obligations are accurately recorded, tracked and action is taken. For business case generation, gather comparable evidence, property valuations, and market data to drive strategic negotiations. Liaise with regional, business and central teams to capture the justification and data necessary for business case approval. Manage subleasing activities, including monitoring sub-tenant compliance, tracking sublease income and key milestones, and coordinating with legal and property management teams. 2. Financial and Procurement Reporting Coordinate with Finance, Tax and Procurement teams for Real Estate budgets, including updating and managing the Real Estate OPEX and CAPEX budget tracking tools. Act as the central point of contact for all property-related budget reporting, preparing quarterly reviews in a clear, digestible format that includes Real Estate and Workplace costs - giving an all inclusive cost per desk / square foot / head. Assist in reporting refurbishment or new office delivery costs, against business as usual spend for operational office locations. Support the coordination of financial and legal documentation required for transactions, such as preparing group structure charts and financials for external parties (e.g., landlords). 3. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Data Collation Lead the coordination and collection of energy, water, and utility consumption data across the global portfolio to support future CSR reporting requirements. Manage the challenge of obtaining utility data in co-working and serviced spaces where direct meter readings are complex, including liaising with local teams, operators and landlords to gather the necessary information. Act as the conduit between the CEO Office and ESG/CSR teams to ensure our portfolio meets the needs of Sustainability policies and or regulatory requirements. 4. Departmental Administrative Support Assist in due diligence and preparation of business cases by researching and reporting on regional office statistics (e.g., desk counts, utilisation, attendance, capacity & commercials). Act as a key liaison for business case presentation and refinement. Maintain dynamic headcount forecasts to ensure space planning aligns with evolving business needs, particularly for high-growth regions. Monitor and document team shift patterns to inform workspace strategy (e.g., HVAC service requirements, after-hours access, and desk rotation models). Monitor and manage utilisation reports for Serviced Offices, along with onboard and offboard leaves to locations where we do not directly manage access control. title: Patient Coordinator

The role of Patient Coordinator will be central to the success of the Signatera product line.  This position will be focused on growing the relationship between Natera and its patients to ensure timely management of testing.  Core responsibilities include collaborating with Nurse Coordinators to increase revenue and drive market development through direct sales by being the key contact for patient needs.  The Patient Coordinator will accomplish this by being the patient advocate within Natera.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Work with assigned Nurse Coordinator to maintain & support existing customers.
  • Assess the needs of patients with a focus on customer support, coordination of logistics, and problem solving.
  • Maintain and support a service-oriented relationship with patients
  • Ensure all data and analysis requests from different parts of the organization are addressed in a timely manner.
  • Help manage our business system tools (e.g. QlikView, Salesforce)
  • Identify, nurture and grow patient relationship in order to influence and schedule ongoing testing.

QUALIFICATIONS:

title: Events & Community Manager
description: About us: Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the role: Restaurant owners trust other restaurant owners. They listen to the chef down the street, their wine supplier and their accountant long before they listen to an ad. That's why our events work. When we launched in Berlin, we hosted a four-hands dinner with two local merchants and a well-known food creator. We believe that’s what builds credibility, trust, and ultimately a warm prospect list. We’re hiring an Events & Community Manager to turn that into a program that runs in several markets at the same time. You’ll plan and run our partner and owned events, and find new ways to grow Tebi through the hospitality community in each city, neighbourhood and market. You’ll work closely with our local sales teams so every event and partnership turns into real conversations. This is a hands-on role. One week you'll be hosting a merchant dinner in Milan, the next you'll be setting up a distributor breakfast in Amsterdam. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our Marketing team to extend these programs to our channel ecosystem, plus align closely with the General Managers and Account Managers in each market. What you'll be doing: Run events across markets: Plan and deliver partner and owned events in 2–3 markets at a time, from intimate merchant dinners and industry breakfasts to city launches. You own the calendar, budget, venues, suppliers, guest lists and the plan for the night. Build the playbook as you go: Turn each event into templates, checklists and supplier lists, so we can launch a city campaign in weeks, not months. Improve them after every event. Build local partner networks: Find the people operators already trust: drinks distributors, wholesalers, food creators, hospitality associations, accountants and the advisers who help new venues open. Build partnerships that bring us introductions and referrals, not just logos. Put our merchants front and center: Work with our best merchants as hosts and anchors, so prospects hear about Tebi from the people they respect. Turn connections into pipeline: Agree with local Sales and Account Management who to involve, how to follow up and who owns what conversations. Track every event in HubSpot from invite to demo to signed merchant. Grow Tebi through the community: Find new ways to reach operators through the people and places they already trust, in each city, neighborhood and across borders. Keep guests and partners engaged after events, so one introduction leads to the next. Open new community channels: Test new ways to grow through our close-knit industry, such as an affiliate or referral program for partners, sharing useful insights from our merchants, and showing up in the forums and groups where operators talk shop. Capture the stories: Work with our creative team and relevant freelancers to turn events and partner moments into social content, case studies and sales material. How we'll measure success: Events delivered each quarter across markets, on time and on budget Demos, pipeline and new merchants from each event and partnership Introductions, referrals and leads from partners, affiliates and community channels Cost per demo compared with our other channels What you’ll bring: Have built something people show up for: an event series, a supper club, a community, a program. You can point to what it led to, not just how many people came Feel at home in hospitality. You've worked in or around restaurants, bars or food and drink brands, and you're comfortable leading a room full of operators Are high agency. You own your calendar, your relationships and your results, and you don't wait to be told what to do Build your own playbook when there isn't one, and you enjoy doing the work as much as planning it Know the difference between a real community and a guest list See growth opportunities beyond events, and are curious enough to test them Can run several markets at once without dropping details, and are happy to travel regularly Track what you do: comfortable with a CRM (HubSpot a plus), UTMs and simple reporting Speak fluent English. Dutch, German, Italian, Spanish or a Nordic language is a plus Typically this means 3–5 years in events, community, field marketing or partnerships, but we care more about what you've built than how long you've been doing it. This role isn't for you if: You'd rather plan the program than run it You need a fixed playbook and a clear org chart to get going You're not willing to roll up your sleeves on the night Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary Lunch Provided in Office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improv

title: Solution Marketing Manager | Luma
description:
Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need

Scientists are solving some of the hardest problems in the world. Your job is to make sure they find the tools that help them do it. 

As a Solution Marketing Manager at Dotmatics, you'll work at the center of science and communication, deeply understanding how researchers in your application area think, what they're trying to accomplish, and what gets in their way. You'll translate that understanding into stories, campaigns, and content that connect scientists with the right solutions at the right moment. 

From a product perspective, Luma and ELN are your primary vehicles. Both require messaging that works at the enterprise level and resonates with specific scientific audiences. Dotmatics also has a broad portfolio of specialized products, each with their own dedicated marketers. Your job is not to own those products, but to connect them into compelling solution narratives when they're relevant to your audience and use case. 

We're looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how scientists work, who loves the challenge of making complex ideas land, and who finds real satisfaction in building something from the ground up. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk. 

In this role you will get to: 

  • Own the positioning, messaging, and content development for your scientific application area: personas, use cases, value propositions, differentiation, and collateral.
  • Develop strategic campaign briefs that translate positioning into actionable guidance for demand generation and integrated marketing.
  • Build and maintain sales enablement materials that help the Dotmatics commercial team have better conversations, including pitch frameworks, solution narratives, objection handling, and competitive context.
  • Partner with the wider marketing team to deliver the message to the market.
  • Engage directly with internal subject matter experts and customers to gather insights and shape strategy.
  • Act as the voice of your scientific audience across marketing and sales, influencing decisions and building alignment across senior stakeholders. 

We are looking for people who have 5+ years in a role where science and communication intersect: marketing, field applications, science communications, or similar, ideally in life sciences or research software. 

  • Scientific grounding to have credible conversations with researchers. A degree in a relevant discipline can be a real advantage here, and relevant hands-on experience is equally welcome.
  • A track record of taking something complicated and making it click for an audience who didn't have time to become an expert.
  • You've had the chance to build something from scratch before, and you want to do it again.
  • You're comfortable working across functions and influencing without direct authority. 

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. 

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

title: PLOS One Associate Editor - Life Sciences
description:
*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA.

 In the US, this is a union represented position as part of the Pacific Media Workers Guild, Local 39521 of the NewsGuild-Communication Workers of America. 

Role Summary 

PLOS is a nonprofit organization on a mission to drive open science forward with measurable, meaningful change in research publishing, policy, and practice. We believe in a better future where science is open to all, for all.  

 The Associate Editor oversees the editorial process for manuscripts submitted to PLOS journals. This role will require the use of prior research experience, critical evaluation skills, and internal guidelines to make nuanced and complex editorial decisions. The Associate Editor works with colleagues in their division and other teams to deliver developmental and promotional activities for PLOS journals. 

 

Responsibilities 

  • Serve as a point of escalation for complex and nuanced editorial queries. 
  • Support other teams at PLOS, members of the editorial board, and third-party editorial teams to ensure high standards of scientific rigor and editorial integrity are upheld. 
  • Evaluate submissions and make decisions based on reviewers’ comments. 
  • Participate in activities to develop editorial policy and improve the visibility and reputation of journals in the PLOS portfolio. 
  • Handle publication ethics queries. 
  • Build relationships with members of the academic community. 
  • Demonstrate a positive, constructive attitude to change and a growth mindset. 

 

Knowledge and Skills 

  • Experience in a research environment, publishing, or other relevant industry. 
  • Highly organized and efficient, with strong critical assessment, and problem-solving abilities. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral. 
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy. 
  • Able to set priorities and work independently. 

 

Qualifications 

  • A PhD is required. 

 

Physical Requirements and Work Environment 

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer 
  • Some national and international travel may be required occasionally 
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones 

 

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is (UK) £35,000 - £38,950 / (US) $67000 to $73,625. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below.  

 

BENEFITS: 

US:

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office 

UK: 

  • Private medical insurance 
  • Life assurance 
  • Income protection  
  • Personal accident insurance 
  • Pension with up to 10% employer match 
  • 25 days holidays, market competitive Maternity and Paternity leave 
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off 
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year 
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all. 

Visit plos.org/careers to learn more.

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

title: Implementation Consultant - Software (Remote)
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
You will partner with top global pharma organisations to solve critical business challenges. By implementing Veeva’s Commercial Cloud products (PromoMats/DAM, and Medical), you will deliver cutting-edge, AI-powered solutions that drive the life sciences industry toward more connected, data-driven customer relationships.

You’ll lead business process due diligence, design and implement robust and scalable solutions, and drive successful projects, through a variety of roles including Project Manager, Lead Solution Architect and PO/Business Analyst. 
 
What makes us different: 
Autonomy and high trust and ownership culture: passion and effort directly lead to opportunities and real ownership from the start
Collaboration without competition: peers root for each other’s success, leadership is entirely accessible, and we tackle complex problems with a strict "no-ego" approach. 
Meaningful Industry Impact: know your work makes a difference, by helping life sciences companies operate more efficiently and effectively
 The ability to travel domestically and abroad is required (VISA not being handled by Veeva). The ideal candidate will be fluent in English and ideally one of the following languages: French, German, Italian, or Spanish. The role is ideally based in the area of a Veeva office (Barcelona, London, Paris, Frankfurt, Berlin), but other EU locations will be considered.
 #RemoteUK #LI-Associate Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world. As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent_accommodations@veeva.com.

title: Fundraising Program Manager (Stage)
description: QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? Sowefund est la plateforme pionnière et leader en France du co-investissement Venture Capital en France. Sowefund appartient au groupe VC : Founders Future, fonds franco-américain tier-1 fondé par Marc Ménasé.Nous appliquons les mêmes standards d'analyse et de sélectivité qu'un fonds de VC institutionnel, tout en démocratisant l'accès à l'investissement early-stage auprès de +160 000 investisseurs particuliers. QUELQUES CHIFFRES : +10 ans d'existence +250 startups financées par le groupe Founders Future x Sowefund, parmi elles : Mon Petit Placement, Lydia, Yuka, ekWateur, Lunii, Bitstack, Veesion, Entent, Campsider... +150M€ levés pour nos entreprises ~30 deals/an du pre-seed à la Series B (tickets de 500K€ à 5M€)+30 verticales d'investissement B2C et B2B : Climate Tech, HealthTech, Mobility, Fintech, Foodtech, Spacetech, Deeptech, E-commerce, Retail, Agritech, Cybersecurity, Edtech, Industrie 4.0... NOTRE MISSION : Pour les fondateurs des meilleures startups européennes : Apporter un double levier unique → des tickets allant jusqu'à 5M€ + du smart money via une communauté de 160K investisseurs engagés qui deviennent ambassadeurs de leur marque (visibilité, business development, réseau, acquisition…). Pour les investisseurs : Démocratiser l'accès aux meilleures startups européennes, du pre-seed à la pre-IPO, aux mêmes conditions d'investissement que les fonds institutionnels. NOTRE AMBISSION : Devenir la plateforme de référence européenne de co-investissement dans le Venture Capital. Concrètement : Expansion européenne, multiplication des projets financés, et positionnement du co-investissement retail comme un standard aux côtés des fonds institutionnels. Vos missions TA MISSION : Envie de plonger au cœur de l’écosystème startup et de participer concrètement à des levées de fonds ? Rejoins notre équipe Fundraising Program et accompagne des fondateurs ambitieux dans des moments clés de leur développement. Tu piloteras plusieurs campagnes de levée de fonds de A à Z : de la préparation des supports jusqu’au lancement du closing, en passant par le suivi de la collecte de fonds. TES RESPONSABILITÉS : Préparer les supports clés de campagne : pitch, one-pager, business plan et rédaction des fiches d’investissement. Onboarder et conseiller les fondateurs : cadrage de la stratégie de levée, définition des enjeux et mise en place du rétroplanning de campagne. Piloter la collecte : suivi des performances, organisation de points hebdomadaires et reporting. Animer la campagne : participation à l’organisation de webinaires / sessions de pitch. Vos compétences Étudiant(e) Bac+4/5 (école de commerce ou université), avec un fort intérêt pour la startup, la finance et l’innovation Rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et à l’aise avec la gestion de plusieurs projets en parallèle (Une première expérience en gestion de projet est un plus). Bonnes bases en finance et compréhension de base des mécanismes d’une levée de fonds. Excellentes capacités de communication écrite et orale. Curieux(se), autonome, avec une vraie envie d’apprendre au contact direct des fondateurs. Avantages Une immersion concrète dans l’univers des startups et du financement ; Des responsabilités dès le premier jour, avec un réel impact ; Une montée en compétences rapide à la croisée de la finance, du conseil et de l’entrepreneuriat ; Une équipe jeune et dynamique. MODALITÉS DU STAGE : Durée : 6 mois Date de début : Janvier 2027 Tickets restaurant / 50% pass navigo Process rapide : First call (15-20 minutes) Case study C-level call Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Support Worker within Mental Health Services / Support Worker within Learning Disability Services

LOCATION:  Essex and and surrounding locations in the East.

PAY RATES: Days £16.81 / Nights £18.91 / Weekends £21.01 

Shifts - flexible and available to work across a variety of shifts, including days, nights, and weekends.

Make a lasting impact by building meaningful relationships.

At Thornbury Community Services (TCS), we believe exceptional care starts with genuine connections. We’re looking for Support Worker within Mental Health Services / Support Worker within Learning Disability Services who are committed to making a real difference—people who truly care and want to build long-term partnerships with those they support.

This isn’t just a job; it’s an opportunity to empower individuals with ASD and Learning Disability to live safe, fulfilled lives. You’ll help clients achieve personal goals, explore new hobbies, and enjoy trips into the community—all while creating relationships that bring lasting satisfaction for both you and them.

What You’ll Do

· Deliver person-centered care within the client’s own home.

· Maintain safety whilst making positive risk decisions.

· Enrich life and promote independence.

· Build trust and long-term relationships that make every day meaningful.

What We Offer

We value our support workers and provide a benefits package designed to help you thrive:

· Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) – confidential wellbeing support.

· Travel and mileage expenses – reimbursed for your shifts.

· Exceptional pay rates – among the highest in the UK.

· Bespoke training and competency development – keep growing in your career.

What We’re Looking For

We want passionate, resilient professionals who can commit to delivering care without exception. To join our team, you’ll need:

· 12 months UK-based experience in a community setting.

· Confidence in maintaining risk and using physical intervention where required.

· Confidence in utilising PBS standards within services.

· Strong personal values and ethical standards.

· Dedication, commitment and stability.

· A genuine desire to build lasting relationships and make a positive impact.

Why Choose TCS?

Joining Thornbury means joining a compassionate team that values people—not just as clients, but as individuals. You’ll enjoy job satisfaction, and the chance to make a difference that lasts.

LOCATION: Fleet, Hampshire

PAY RATES: £16.81 - £21.01 per hour (including holiday pay).

  • Day shifts between 8.00am and 8.00 pm
  • Waking night and sleep-in shift opportunities
